dossier.claim: Recurring errors assign a voice, action, condition, or comparative role to the wrong participant. The broad scene can remain recognizable even when its local roles are reversed.
dossier.sourcePattern: The Japanese uses a voice answered with politeness, a topic followed by an explicit taking-away agent, the narrator’s envy of his joyful rescuer, and an explicit first-person subject in Saber’s ability comparison. Detection also distinguishes the mage sensed from the mage doing the sensing.
dossier.englishEffect: A father’s grave voice moves into Rin’s reply, Illya’s taking Sakura away becomes Sakura taking Illya away, and Shirou’s envy of his joyful rescuer becomes the rescuer’s envy of the dying child. Sakura’s blush is assigned to Tohsaka even though Tohsaka is next door. Strong magical energy becomes better detection instead of making its bearer easier to detect.
dossier.limits: Japanese omitted participants require scene evidence; a plausible mood alone cannot settle a subject. Unmarked possessors and ambiguous English pronouns are withheld when competing readings remain viable. These examples have clearer grammatical or contextual constraints. Preserved subjective attraction and the reciprocal contract limit any claim that role handling fails everywhere.
dossier.diagnostic: 684 findings in this category; 8 cited passages.

contexts.japanese: 横合いから放たれた、無数の光弾の前に弾かれていた
contexts.english: She is shot from the side by numerous light bullets.

findings.description: Shirou’s conclusion that Rin will always be an ally becomes an assurance that she can count on him.
findings.sourceReading: 遠坂はずっと味方 makes Rin his continuing ally; her reply limits it to a short time.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s conclusion that Rin will always be an ally becomes an assurance that she can count on him.

contexts.japanese: それなら遠坂はずっと味方
contexts.english: Then you can count on me.

findings.description: Admiring an unrecognized part of her character becomes admiring her failure to look at herself.
findings.sourceReading: あの女が自分でも気付いていない部分 is a part/aspect of the woman that even she has not noticed; that aspect is what Issei admires.
findings.explanation: Admiring an unrecognized part of her character becomes admiring her failure to look at herself.

contexts.japanese: 俺が感心したのは、あの女が自分でも気付いていない部分の話
contexts.english: What I admire was that she doesn't look at herself.

findings.description: Recognizing their shared panic is replaced with blaming her for dragging him in.
findings.sourceReading: パニクったのは俺も同じ recognizes that he too panicked at the sudden situation, before calling her one-sided glare unfair.
findings.explanation: Recognizing their shared panic is replaced with blaming her for dragging him in.

contexts.japanese: いきなりのコトでパニクったのは俺も同じ
contexts.english: You're the one who dragged me in like that.

findings.description: The accusation that they foisted Rider on him becomes merely receiving a bad Servant.
findings.sourceReading: おまえたち followed by 掴ませやがって explicitly accuses his interlocutors of giving him a worthless Rider.
findings.explanation: The accusation that they foisted Rider on him becomes merely receiving a bad Servant.

contexts.japanese: ライダーなんてカスを掴ませやがって
contexts.english: It's so unfair I got a piece of shit like Rider!

findings.description: A firm utterance becomes an obligation to do everything possible.
findings.sourceReading: きっぱりと言う describes the delivery of his immediately preceding recipe correction.
findings.explanation: A firm utterance becomes an obligation to do everything possible.

contexts.japanese: きっぱりと言う
contexts.english: I have to do everything I can.

findings.description: Shirou’s reluctance to recognize an enemy becomes preventing Saber’s recognition.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator explains his deliberate withholding: he wants to avoid treating Shinji as an enemy before knowing his intentions.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s reluctance to recognize an enemy becomes preventing Saber’s recognition.

contexts.japanese: 敵と認識する事は避けたかった
contexts.english: I don't want her to consider him an enemy

contexts.japanese: 敵と認識する事は避けたかった
contexts.english: I don't want her to consider him an enemy

contexts.japanese: 敵と認識する事は避けたかった
contexts.english: I don't want her to consider him an enemy

findings.description: Only Shirou listens for the warning instead of Shirou and Caster.
findings.sourceReading: Both the narrator and Caster strain to hear Archer before the command to dodge becomes clear.
findings.explanation: Only Shirou listens for the warning instead of Shirou and Caster.

contexts.japanese: 俺とキャスターが耳を澄ませた時
contexts.english: I try to make out what he's saying

findings.description: The fortunate direction of rescued lives becomes the hero’s blessed life.
findings.sourceReading: After saying he changed many people’s fates, the narrator judges those changes as at least tending toward happiness, then confirms his struggle was not wasted.
findings.explanation: The fortunate direction of rescued lives becomes the hero’s blessed life.

contexts.japanese: 控えめに言っても、それは幸福よりだったろう
contexts.english: his life was full of blessedness.

findings.description: The English places the silent figure behind Shirou instead of behind Rin, changing the rooftop arrangement.
findings.sourceReading: After Rin looks angrily at Shirou, the narration places the silently rejecting figure behind her.
findings.explanation: The English places the silent figure behind Shirou instead of behind Rin, changing the rooftop arrangement.

contexts.japanese: その背後には
contexts.english: Behind me...

findings.description: Caster's impending disappearance from exhaustion becomes something she is trying to accomplish, changing the agency of her desperate situation.
findings.sourceReading: Caster is on the verge of disappearing alone because killing her Master has deprived her of sustaining magical energy.
findings.explanation: Caster's impending disappearance from exhaustion becomes something she is trying to accomplish, changing the agency of her desperate situation.

contexts.japanese: 独り消えようとしていた
contexts.english: was trying to disappear

findings.description: No rescuer becomes nothing saved.
findings.sourceReading: 助けてくれるモノなどいない means no one/thing will help him.
findings.explanation: No rescuer becomes nothing saved.

contexts.japanese: 助けてくれるモノなどいない
contexts.english: nothing would be saved

findings.description: Deceiving one another becomes deceiving themselves.
findings.sourceReading: 互い marks the reciprocal object of the two people’s bluff.
findings.explanation: Deceiving one another becomes deceiving themselves.

contexts.japanese: 互いを騙し通すため
contexts.english: so that we can deceive ourselves.

findings.description: Rin’s readiness for loss becomes the priest’s readiness.
findings.sourceReading: However prepared she is as a mage, even with him also belonging to their world, this would not be easy for her.
findings.explanation: Rin’s readiness for loss becomes the priest’s readiness.

contexts.japanese: どんなに魔術師として覚悟していて、あの神父もこちら側の人間だったとしても
contexts.english: Even if he was involved and prepared as a mage

findings.description: Archer's warning that he could be compelled to attack Caster becomes a warning that Rin will attack her. This obscures why breaking Archer's contract is urgent.
findings.sourceReading: Archer urges Caster to break his contract before Rin can use her remaining Command Spell to make him attack Caster.
findings.explanation: Archer's warning that he could be compelled to attack Caster becomes a warning that Rin will attack her. This obscures why breaking Archer's contract is urgent.

contexts.japanese: 早くしなければおまえに襲いかかってしまうぞ
contexts.english: She will attack you if you don't hurry.

findings.description: Kuzuki's effort to prevent either protagonist escaping becomes a shared intention to hold one another in place.
findings.sourceReading: Kuzuki maintains the standoff to prevent either Shirou or Rin from escaping.
findings.explanation: Kuzuki's effort to prevent either protagonist escaping becomes a shared intention to hold one another in place.

contexts.japanese: どちらかを逃がさない為
contexts.english: so that we don't let each other go.

findings.description: Rin’s vexation becomes a vexing action.
findings.sourceReading: 悔しげ describes her frustration apparent in lip-biting.
findings.explanation: Rin’s vexation becomes a vexing action.

contexts.japanese: 悔しげに唇を噛んでいた
contexts.english: she's biting her lip vexingly.

findings.description: Two capture branches repeat self-controlled stopping.
findings.sourceReading: Internal rotation stops in externally imposed helplessness, followed by forced sensory shutdown.
findings.explanation: Two capture branches repeat self-controlled stopping.

contexts.japanese: 回転も止められた
contexts.english: I was able to stop the rotation

contexts.japanese: 回転も止められた
contexts.english: I was able to stop the rotation

findings.description: A group comparison becomes only Caster’s personal imagination.
findings.sourceReading: 私たち frames inability to imagine the resistance collectively.
findings.explanation: A group comparison becomes only Caster’s personal imagination.

contexts.japanese: 私たちでは考えられない
contexts.english: I can't imagine resisting

findings.description: A pitying face becomes a pitiful face.
findings.sourceReading: 同情するような means the other person looks as though she pities Illya.
findings.explanation: A pitying face becomes a pitiful face.

contexts.japanese: その同情するような顔
contexts.english: Your pitiful face

findings.description: No reason to fight Kuzuki becomes no reason for Kuzuki to fight.
findings.sourceReading: 葛木と戦う considers the observers’ justification for fighting him.
findings.explanation: No reason to fight Kuzuki becomes no reason for Kuzuki to fight.

contexts.japanese: 葛木と戦う理由など何処にもない
contexts.english: any more reasons for Kuzuki to keep fighting

findings.description: The attacker’s full force becomes the victim’s nonresistance.
findings.sourceReading: 力任せに describes Saber’s force; the next sentence specifies a several-meter throw.
findings.explanation: The attacker’s full force becomes the victim’s nonresistance.

contexts.japanese: 力任せに倒された
contexts.english: I was knocked down without resisting.

contexts.japanese: 体は数メートルも弾き飛ばされ
contexts.english: My body is sent flying

findings.description: Shirou’s breathlessness is assigned to Saber.
findings.sourceReading: The collision leaves the narrator unable to breathe normally.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s breathlessness is assigned to Saber.

contexts.japanese: おかげでまともに息ができない
contexts.english: Because of that, she can barely catch her breath.

findings.description: Sensory overrun becomes a deliberate coping strategy.
findings.sourceReading: The eyes cannot keep up with analysis and the senses run out of control.
findings.explanation: Sensory overrun becomes a deliberate coping strategy.

contexts.japanese: 肉眼では追い付かず感覚が暴走し
contexts.english: what I need to do now is let my senses take over and analyze them.

findings.description: Rin's explicit personal resolve becomes a collective declaration.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女ははっきり口にした says Rin herself clearly states that she will end the battle.
findings.explanation: Rin's explicit personal resolve becomes a collective declaration.

contexts.japanese: この戦いを終わらせると、彼女ははっきり口にした
contexts.english: She has said it clearly that we will end this fight.

findings.description: Rin's longstanding suspicion is assigned to an unidentified plural group.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she had long been watching Ryudou Temple as this War's manifestation site.
findings.explanation: Rin's longstanding suspicion is assigned to an unidentified plural group.

contexts.japanese: 前から今回の降霊場所は柳洞寺だと睨んでたのよ
contexts.english: They have been eyeing the temple as the place to manifest the Grail.

findings.description: Rin's surveillance familiar becomes a familiar placed by an invented overseer.
findings.sourceReading: For Caster countermeasures, Rin had released a familiar serving as a lookout; its destruction supports her inference.
findings.explanation: Rin's surveillance familiar becomes a familiar placed by an invented overseer.

contexts.japanese: キャスター対策で監視役の使い魔を放ってた
contexts.english: The overseer placed a familiar there to counter Caster

findings.description: Rin's intention to go to Shirou becomes an intention to find both Shirou and Saber for a discussion.
findings.sourceReading: アンタんところ is singular: she had just been about to go to Shirou's place.
findings.explanation: Rin's intention to go to Shirou becomes an intention to find both Shirou and Saber for a discussion.

contexts.japanese: ちょうどアンタんところに行こうと思ってたところだから
contexts.english: I was just thinking about going to find you guys to talk about something.

findings.description: Shirou's Projection showing its limitations becomes Gilgamesh noticing it.
findings.sourceReading: ボロが出る says even one projected Archer sword exposes Shirou's inadequacy or strain.
findings.explanation: Shirou's Projection showing its limitations becomes Gilgamesh noticing it.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーの剣を一本投影するだけでボロが出るんだぞ
contexts.english: He can tell that as soon as I Project one of Archer's swords.

findings.description: Shirou's doubt that he can use the gems becomes doubt that Rin will agree.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot imagine someone without magical aptitude like him handling them.
findings.explanation: Shirou's doubt that he can use the gems becomes doubt that Rin will agree.

contexts.japanese: 元から魔術の素養がない俺がそれをなんとかできるとは、やっぱり思えない
contexts.english: I don't think she'll agree to that seeing that I don't have any training in magecraft to be able to utilize those gems.

findings.description: Rin's mana plus all Shirou's circuits becomes all of both people's circuits.
findings.sourceReading: The Reality Marble requires Rin's magical energy and Shirou's complete circuit set.
findings.explanation: Rin's mana plus all Shirou's circuits becomes all of both people's circuits.

contexts.japanese: 私の魔力と士郎の全魔術回路を使って初めて
contexts.english: when we fully exert all of our Magic Circuits.

findings.description: Rin's glowing crest-bearing arm becomes Shirou's arm already receiving mana.
findings.sourceReading: Rin extends her bare left arm; its upper-arm pattern appears as it gains energy.
findings.explanation: Rin's glowing crest-bearing arm becomes Shirou's arm already receiving mana.

contexts.japanese: 腕は剥き出しで、二の腕の模様が魔力を得てうっすらと浮かび上がっていた
contexts.english: As I began receiving magical energy, the pattern on the upper area of my exposed arm faintly started to shine.

findings.description: The process stripping unnecessary parts becomes Shirou deliberately severing them.
findings.sourceReading: He has been pared down of things unnecessary there and discovers his limbs gone.
findings.explanation: The process stripping unnecessary parts becomes Shirou deliberately severing them.

contexts.japanese: 余分なもの、此処では無くてもいいものを削られてきた
contexts.english: I already severed things that I've deemed unnecessary to this place

findings.description: An unspecified farewell acquires romance and fixed genders.
findings.sourceReading: Someone remembers seeing another person off knowing they will never hold hands again.
findings.explanation: An unspecified farewell acquires romance and fixed genders.

contexts.japanese: もう手を繋ぐ事はないと見送った余人の記憶
contexts.english: The memory of a person who watched their loved one leave knowing she would never hold his hands again.

findings.description: Shirou overcoming disgust becomes Rin not feeling disgust.
findings.sourceReading: After recognizing Rin's pain and admiring her, Shirou says his own experience is no longer disgusting.
findings.explanation: Shirou overcoming disgust becomes Rin not feeling disgust.

contexts.japanese: 気持ちの悪さなどない
contexts.english: She doesn't feel any disgust.

findings.description: Rin watching until sunset becomes the jumper trying until sunset.
findings.sourceReading: 意味もなく modifies her sustained watching; his repeated runs were already stated.
findings.explanation: Rin watching until sunset becomes the jumper trying until sunset.

contexts.japanese: 意味もなく、日が沈むまで
contexts.english: It was meaningless, yet he kept trying until sunset.

findings.description: Rin refusing to let Shirou apologize becomes refusing to apologize herself.
findings.sourceReading: ごめん、なんて言わせない makes Shirou the prospective apologizer.
findings.explanation: Rin refusing to let Shirou apologize becomes refusing to apologize herself.

contexts.japanese: ごめん、なんて言わせないわ
contexts.english: don't expect me to apologize.

findings.description: Shirou being unable to finish becomes Rin refusing to hear him out.
findings.sourceReading: He does not get to hear or ask through to the end before ejection.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unable to finish becomes Rin refusing to hear him out.

contexts.japanese: 最後まで聞けなかった
contexts.english: She won't hear me out at all.

findings.description: The raining arrows' destruction is assigned to Rin.
findings.sourceReading: Arrows from overhead shatter every tentacle, net, and platform obstructing her route.
findings.explanation: The raining arrows' destruction is assigned to Rin.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の行く手を阻む全てを粉砕する
contexts.english: She smashes everything that gets in her way, whether it is a net, platform, or tentacles of meat

findings.description: Rin's magical energy receiving her cry becomes magical energy replying to it.
findings.sourceReading: Her mana catches/carries the shouted plea, enabling Saber to answer with the holy sword.
findings.explanation: Rin's magical energy receiving her cry becomes magical energy replying to it.

contexts.japanese: 叫ぶ声を、彼女の魔力が受け止める
contexts.english: Her magical energy replies to the screaming voice.

findings.description: Shirou gripping the chain so he will not let go becomes the chain refusing to release him.
findings.sourceReading: He deliberately reverses his prior resistance, winds the chain deeply, and grips it so the two cannot separate.
findings.explanation: Shirou gripping the chain so he will not let go becomes the chain refusing to release him.

contexts.japanese: 決して離れないよう鎖を掴み
contexts.english: I grab onto the chain so that it won't let me go.

findings.description: Archer entrusting his other self to Rin becomes asking care for the present Archer.
findings.sourceReading: 私を頼む deliberately overlaps Archer with the distant boy, then immediately identifies that unreliable guy as the one Rin must support.
findings.explanation: Archer entrusting his other self to Rin becomes asking care for the present Archer.

contexts.japanese: 私を頼む。知っての通り頼りないヤツだからな
contexts.english: Please take care of me. I am an unreliable guy, as you know.

contexts.japanese: 君が、支えてやってくれ
contexts.english: Please support me.

findings.description: Caster's side is reduced to Caster alone in the role confirmation.
findings.sourceReading: While Lancer separates Archer and Saber, Shirou and Rin confront Caster and her associates, including Kuzuki.
findings.explanation: Caster's side is reduced to Caster alone in the role confirmation.

contexts.japanese: 俺と遠坂はキャスターたちと対決する
contexts.english: We will use that opening to fight Caster.

findings.description: Lancer's sense that something does not add up becomes Archer's disgruntlement. This removes the thought that leads into Lancer questioning his own performance.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer pauses to inspect Archer because something does not add up to him, leading into his questioning of Archer's strength and his own restraint.
findings.explanation: Lancer's sense that something does not add up becomes Archer's disgruntlement. This removes the thought that leads into Lancer questioning his own performance.

contexts.japanese: どうも納得がいかぬ、と赤い弓兵を観察する。
contexts.english: He observes the disgruntled bowman in red.

findings.description: Lancer's all-out blow is made to look self-directed.
findings.sourceReading: The action is an all-out Lancer attack against Archer, canceled by an equally all-out Archer attack; neither combatant is about to hit himself.
findings.explanation: Lancer's all-out blow is made to look self-directed.

contexts.japanese: 自身に叩きつけるようなランサー渾身の一撃は、同じくアーチャー渾身の一撃によって相殺された。
contexts.english: Lancer's full-force blow, as if he is about to hit himself, is offset by Archer's full-force attack.

findings.description: The English makes the manner of Kuzuki's advance mysterious; the Japanese says Shirou does not even notice the advance itself.
findings.sourceReading: Kuzuki closes the distance without Shirou even noticing his forward movement.
findings.explanation: The English makes the manner of Kuzuki's advance mysterious; the Japanese says Shirou does not even notice the advance itself.

contexts.japanese: 前進した事も気づかせないまま間合いを詰める葛木。
contexts.english: Kuzuki closes in, without revealing how he advanced.

findings.description: The third-person concurrent account is assigned to Shirou with a first-person knowledge claim.
findings.sourceReading: The narration has shifted to Rin's simultaneous fight and says that the number of jewels she owns is unknown before giving Caster's rough estimate.
findings.explanation: The third-person concurrent account is assigned to Shirou with a first-person knowledge claim.

contexts.japanese: 彼女がどれほど宝石を所有しているかは知らぬが、所詮十や二十。
contexts.english: I do not know how many jewels she has, but it should be around ten or twenty.

findings.description: A pronoun makes protected Kuzuki the exception to his own protection.
findings.sourceReading: Kuzuki is presumably protected by Caster, while Shirou alone is the exception and would burn if Rin let the area spell activate.
findings.explanation: A pronoun makes protected Kuzuki the exception to his own protection.

contexts.japanese: 葛木はキャスターによって護られているだろうが、彼だけは例外なのだ。
contexts.english: Kuzuki should be protected by Caster, but he is an exception.

findings.description: Caster's feet become the subject that lands on her back.
findings.sourceReading: Her feet are swept out and Caster falls onto her back.
findings.explanation: Caster's feet become the subject that lands on her back.

contexts.japanese: 足を払われ、背中から地面に倒れゆくキャスター。
contexts.english: Caster's feet are swept beneath her and lands on her back.

findings.description: Shirou’s unfinished request that Lancer go home makes Shirou himself the person going home.
findings.sourceReading: Too exhausted for a long explanation, Shirou begins telling Lancer to go home quietly before Saber interrupts him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s unfinished request that Lancer go home makes Shirou himself the person going home.

contexts.japanese: 大人しく帰って
contexts.english: I should go home

findings.description: Archer offers his posthumous self to the World but English offers his body.
findings.sourceReading: He enters the bargain by offering what he will be after death—his continuing self as a Guardian.
findings.explanation: Archer offers his posthumous self to the World but English offers his body.

contexts.japanese: 死後の自分を差し出して
contexts.english: to give his body after death

findings.description: Never being understood becomes being unknown to life.
findings.sourceReading: Not once was he understood by others.
findings.explanation: Never being understood becomes being unknown to life.

contexts.japanese: ただの一度も理解されない。
contexts.english: nor known to Life.

findings.description: A mirror comparison becomes a purpose clause.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou denies Archer just as Archer refuses to acknowledge the former Emiya Shirou; the two rejections mirror one another.
findings.explanation: A mirror comparison becomes a purpose clause.

contexts.japanese: あいつがかつての衛宮士郎を認めないように。
contexts.english: So that he doesn't approve of the former Shirou Emiya.

findings.description: Archer says he came because he was promised no interruption, but English says he chose the place.
findings.sourceReading: He addresses the visitor: he came because he had been told no one would interfere; the speaker who supplied that assurance is not identified here.
findings.explanation: Archer says he came because he was promised no interruption, but English says he chose the place.

contexts.japanese: 邪魔は入らんというから来てやったのだがな
contexts.english: I chose this place since I was told there would be no interruptions here.

findings.description: Shinji turning toward the entrance becomes returning to it.
findings.sourceReading: He turns back to face the entrance, revealing the powerful figure supporting his boast; he does not walk back there in this sentence.
findings.explanation: Shinji turning toward the entrance becomes returning to it.

contexts.japanese: 間桐慎二は入り口に振り返る。
contexts.english: Shinji Matou smiles and returns to the entrance.

findings.description: Lancer's casual verbal reply becomes his departure.
findings.sourceReading: He answers lightly with あいよ; only after that does he stop and turn rather than depart.
findings.explanation: Lancer's casual verbal reply becomes his departure.

contexts.japanese: あいよ、と気軽に声を返す。
contexts.english: Lancer departs with an "aye."

findings.description: Archer personally witnessing and incinerating human karma becomes an action by Guardians as a group.
findings.sourceReading: The continuing subject is the singular man: again and again, he saw human self-destruction and burned it away like trash with his own hands.
findings.explanation: Archer personally witnessing and incinerating human karma becomes an action by Guardians as a group.

contexts.japanese: 自らの手で滅びようとする人間の業を目の当たりにし、それを、ゴミのように焼き払ってきた。
contexts.english: Whenever they see humans do something that causes their own destruction, they show up and burn it all.

findings.description: An unintentional blow that spares Shinji's life becomes Shinji looking unconscious.
findings.sourceReading: Because Lancer struck without conscious intent, he apparently avoided killing Shinji; worse harm to Rin would have prompted deliberate retaliation.
findings.explanation: An unintentional blow that spares Shinji's life becomes Shinji looking unconscious.

contexts.japanese: 無意識だったので殺さずに済んだらしい。
contexts.english: He looks unconscious, but not dead.

findings.description: The English replaces Shinji's unsteady steps with eagerness. His excitement fits the scene, but the bodily instability accompanying his loss of restraint disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji approaches Rin with unsteady steps as his rational restraint is coming undone.
findings.explanation: The English replaces Shinji's unsteady steps with eagerness. His excitement fits the scene, but the bodily instability accompanying his loss of restraint disappears.

contexts.japanese: おぼつかない足取りで遠坂凛へと近寄っていく。
contexts.english: he closes in on Rin eagerly.

findings.description: Shinji running his fingers over Rin's body becomes merely reaching for it.
findings.sourceReading: He crawls his fingers along her restrained body; Lancer strikes at the instant of this contact.
findings.explanation: Shinji running his fingers over Rin's body becomes merely reaching for it.

contexts.japanese: 間桐慎二は少女の体に指を這わせる。
contexts.english: Shinji reaches for Rin's body.

findings.description: Lancer aiming his spear between Shinji's eyes becomes bringing his face close to Shinji's. The next page restores the spear threat, but this moment loses its precise, controlled intimidation.
findings.sourceReading: The object carried forward from withdrawing the spear is the spear itself: Lancer precisely aims it between Shinji's eyebrows.
findings.explanation: Lancer aiming his spear between Shinji's eyes becomes bringing his face close to Shinji's. The next page restores the spear threat, but this moment loses its precise, controlled intimidation.

contexts.japanese: 間桐慎二の眉間に合わせた。
contexts.english: He puts his face in front of Shinji's.

findings.description: Lancer's deeply amused murmur becomes a hearty laugh. The pleasure survives, but the farewell changes from quiet teasing to an overt burst of laughter.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer's muttered reply to Rin sounds deeply amused or delighted.
findings.explanation: Lancer's deeply amused murmur becomes a hearty laugh. The pleasure survives, but the farewell changes from quiet teasing to an overt burst of laughter.

contexts.japanese: 呟いた言葉は、心底愉しげだった。
contexts.english: A hearty guffaw escapes his lips.

findings.description: A partially successful evasion becomes a failed attempt to evade.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou twists away, but not by a mere paper-thin margin: the nonfatal cut still slices flesh and may become fatal.
findings.explanation: A partially successful evasion becomes a failed attempt to evade.

contexts.japanese: 身をひねって躱すも、薄皮一枚とはいかない。
contexts.english: I desperately try to avoid the strike, but I can't.

findings.description: Shirou holding his breath becomes Archer holding his breath.
findings.sourceReading: The first-person sequence remains in Shirou's viewpoint: his breath stops because Archer is about to verbalize the memories he saw.
findings.explanation: Shirou holding his breath becomes Archer holding his breath.

contexts.japanese: 息が止まる。
contexts.english: He holds his breath.

findings.description: A projected Kanshou distorting from one hit becomes Shirou creating it and barely deflecting the hit.
findings.sourceReading: The Kanshou made with all his remaining strength is already present; a single blow warps it.
findings.explanation: A projected Kanshou distorting from one hit becomes Shirou creating it and barely deflecting the hit.

contexts.japanese: 残った全精力で作り上げた干将も、わずか一撃で歪曲した。
contexts.english: I scrounge up every bit of mental focus I have left to create a Kanshou, and just barely deflect another slash.

findings.description: Kanshou bending and fading becomes Kanshou breaking while Shirou's life fades.
findings.sourceReading: The distorted Kanshou bends and its own existence grows thin; Shirou then feels pain in his chest from Archer's words.
findings.explanation: Kanshou bending and fading becomes Kanshou breaking while Shirou's life fades.

contexts.japanese: その干将も歪に折れ曲がり、存在そのものが薄れかかっている。
contexts.english: Kanshou breaks, and my life begins to peter out.

findings.description: Kiritsugu pursuing an impossible ideal becomes Shirou following him because it was impossible.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recognizes that Kiritsugu continued pursuing the dream precisely despite knowing it could not be realized.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu pursuing an impossible ideal becomes Shirou following him because it was impossible.

contexts.japanese: 叶わない夢、有り得ない理想だからこそ、切嗣は追い続けた。
contexts.english: I followed in Kiritsugu's footsteps because it's a dream that won't come true and an impossible ideal.

findings.description: Archer parrying one incoming stroke becomes merely wielding his sword skillfully.
findings.sourceReading: He instantly reverses his longsword and handles/parries Shirou's swinging blade.
findings.explanation: Archer parrying one incoming stroke becomes merely wielding his sword skillfully.

contexts.japanese: 咄嗟に長剣を返し、振るわれる一刀を捌く。
contexts.english: He wields his longsword with swift skill.

findings.description: Shirou cries out instead of his oxygen-starved muscles.
findings.sourceReading: His muscles scream for oxygen and his critically low blood volume continually commands activity to stop.
findings.explanation: Shirou cries out instead of his oxygen-starved muscles.

contexts.japanese: 筋肉は酸素を求めて悲鳴をあげ、足りなすぎる血液は運動停止を命じ続ける。
contexts.english: He cries out, his muscles begging for oxygen. They demand that he stop due to a lack of blood.

findings.description: Archer being irritated by the persistent dying enemy becomes the enemy being offended.
findings.sourceReading: Archer receives the blows irritably; the half-dead enemy grates on his nerves, as does his own refusal to step back.
findings.explanation: Archer being irritated by the persistent dying enemy becomes the enemy being offended.

contexts.japanese: 死に損ないの敵も癇に障るが
contexts.english: It seems to offend his stubbornly persistent enemy

findings.description: Shirou being cursed by himself becomes the oath turning out to be a curse.
findings.sourceReading: Even if the world hates him and he curses his own self in this confrontation, he will not relinquish the wish.
findings.explanation: Shirou being cursed by himself becomes the oath turning out to be a curse.

contexts.japanese: 世界中の人間に疎まれても、こうして自分自身に呪われても、それだけは—
contexts.english: Even if the whole world shuns me and the oath turns out to be a curse, I won't give it up.

findings.description: Shirou resetting into a large sword stance becomes re-sheathing the sword.
findings.sourceReading: After deflecting Archer's blade, Shirou readies his sword again in an especially large posture for the final strike.
findings.explanation: Shirou resetting into a large sword stance becomes re-sheathing the sword.

contexts.japanese: 剣を弾き、一際大きく剣を構え直す敵の姿。
contexts.english: The enemy flicks his sword and re-sheathes it in a single, large stance.

findings.description: Archer's exposed left chest and easy defensive return become an exposed left arm and closing distance.
findings.sourceReading: Archer's left chest is open; he swings the longsword back to guard it, and for him that defense should easily arrive in time.
findings.explanation: Archer's exposed left chest and easy defensive return become an exposed left arm and closing distance.

contexts.japanese: 敵の左胸はがら空きだ。
contexts.english: The enemy's left arm is wide open.

contexts.japanese: 彼ならば、それは容易く間に合う行為だ。
contexts.english: It would be easy to close the distance.

findings.description: Shirou turning attention back to his body becomes looking around.
findings.sourceReading: With the tension gone, Shirou can finally review or attend to the state of his own body.
findings.explanation: Shirou turning attention back to his body becomes looking around.

contexts.japanese: ようやく自分の体に振り返る。
contexts.english: I finally look around

findings.description: Rin suffering from the landing impact becomes hugging herself.
findings.sourceReading: She jumps from the second-floor terrace and cries out from the shock and pain of landing.
findings.explanation: Rin suffering from the landing impact becomes hugging herself.

contexts.japanese: 落下の衝撃に苦しんだ。
contexts.english: Hugs herself from the pain of the fall.

findings.description: Archer's figure disappearing from view becomes Archer leaving.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou sees the red figure before it vanishes into dust and rubble; the scene does not yet establish voluntary departure or final fate.
findings.explanation: Archer's figure disappearing from view becomes Archer leaving.

contexts.japanese: その姿が消え去る前に、たしかに見た。
contexts.english: I'm sure I saw him before he left.

findings.description: Archer's conviction that Gilgamesh is no match for Shirou becomes no match for 'us.'
findings.sourceReading: Through Archer's eyes, Shirou understands that he himself is the golden Servant's natural enemy; Saber and Rin are explicitly excluded.
findings.explanation: Archer's conviction that Gilgamesh is no match for Shirou becomes no match for 'us.'

contexts.japanese: あのサーヴァントは、衛宮士郎の敵ではない。
contexts.english: this Servant is no match for us.

findings.description: A deficient Master taking energy from others becomes Gilgamesh taking it himself.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh agrees that when his anchor cannot supply its own deficit, taking from other people is the natural solution; he then reveals he did not actually need that trouble after incarnation.
findings.explanation: A deficient Master taking energy from others becomes Gilgamesh taking it himself.

contexts.japanese: 自己で補えなければ他人から奪うのは当然だろう。
contexts.english: If he can't supply me with energy, then I take it from others

findings.description: Laughter resembling a coughing fit becomes laughter turning into an actual coughing fit.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji laughs in a cough-like manner as his injured arm hangs uselessly.
findings.explanation: Laughter resembling a coughing fit becomes laughter turning into an actual coughing fit.

contexts.japanese: 咳き込むように笑う。
contexts.english: His laugh turns into a coughing fit.

findings.description: Shinji's complaint that Lancer took Rin from him becomes a complaint that Lancer “got” him. This obscures the possessive grievance, although it need not refer only to his injury.
findings.sourceReading: Following the statement that Rin escaped, Shinji complains about having her taken from him by someone who was nearly dead.
findings.explanation: Shinji's complaint that Lancer took Rin from him becomes a complaint that Lancer “got” him. This obscures the possessive grievance, although it need not refer only to his injury.

contexts.japanese: あんな死に損ないにとられるなんて、思い出しただけで吐き気がする！
contexts.english: I want to throw up just thinking about how that cockroach got me!

findings.description: Gilgamesh thrusting his arm into Shinji becomes thrusting it outward.
findings.sourceReading: Without ceremony, he drives his arm into the selected host; the next page delays Shinji's recognition of the impact.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh thrusting his arm into Shinji becomes thrusting it outward.

contexts.japanese: 無造作に、その腕を突き立てていた。
contexts.english: he casually thrusts his arm out.

findings.description: Rin managing the two-way magical-energy allocation becomes the allocation working itself out.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she can manage because Shirou's share is small relative to Saber's, though reckless output remains impossible.
findings.explanation: Rin managing the two-way magical-energy allocation becomes the allocation working itself out.

contexts.japanese: 士郎に分ける魔力は小さいからなんとかやっていけるわ。
contexts.english: I'm not giving you much power compared to Saber, so it'll work itself out.

findings.description: Rin's prior instruction becomes Saber having announced her own decision.
findings.sourceReading: Rin told Saber to use the holy sword if Saber judges she cannot hold Gilgamesh back; Rin then explains the consequences.
findings.explanation: Rin's prior instruction becomes Saber having announced her own decision.

contexts.japanese: 聖剣を使うようには言ってある。
contexts.english: Saber said that she'll use her sacred sword

findings.description: Shirou holding his breath becomes an unnamed male third person doing so.
findings.sourceReading: The first-person viewpoint remains Shirou's; his breath stops as he realizes the second sword use may require Saber's disappearance.
findings.explanation: Shirou holding his breath becomes an unnamed male third person doing so.

contexts.japanese: 息が止まる。
contexts.english: He holds his breath.

findings.description: Shirou condemning himself for missing Rin's pain becomes condemning Rin as a fool.
findings.sourceReading: Realizing that Rin also does not want Saber to disappear, Shirou calls himself an idiot for failing to see her distress.
findings.explanation: Shirou condemning himself for missing Rin's pain becomes condemning Rin as a fool.

contexts.japanese: くそ、なんて馬鹿だ。
contexts.english: Damn it. What a fool she is.

findings.description: Saber's measured exhalation and physical preparation become inhaling and considering her condition.
findings.sourceReading: With one minute remaining, she exhales the deep breath she drew and adjusts her bodily condition.
findings.explanation: Saber's measured exhalation and physical preparation become inhaling and considering her condition.

contexts.japanese: 深く吸い込んだ息を吐いて、体調を整える。
contexts.english: Saber breathes in deeply and considers her condition.

findings.description: Caster's inability as a bodiless Servant to anchor another Servant becomes Assassin needing a physical body.
findings.sourceReading: Even a magus cannot sustain a Servant when that magus is herself a non-corporeal Servant; the anchor must belong to the current era, so Caster selected the gate.
findings.explanation: Caster's inability as a bodiless Servant to anchor another Servant becomes Assassin needing a physical body.

contexts.japanese: いかに魔術師と言えど、実体を持たぬサーヴァントにサーヴァントは維持できぬ。
contexts.english: A Servant cannot maintain themselves without a physical body, even if one is a mage.

findings.description: Rin and Shirou arriving in time to confront Gilgamesh becomes arriving while Saber is already fighting him.
findings.sourceReading: Saber must hurry because otherwise the pair will catch up to the Gilgamesh battle; in the worst case they confront him before she even reaches the precincts.
findings.explanation: Rin and Shirou arriving in time to confront Gilgamesh becomes arriving while Saber is already fighting him.

contexts.japanese: 急がなければ、ふたりはギルガメッシュとの戦いに間に合ってしまう。
contexts.english: Unless she hurries, her allies will arrive while she's fighting Gilgamesh.

findings.description: Gilgamesh aiming an unfamiliar straight sword becomes Shirou responding and pointing it toward himself.
findings.sourceReading: In response to Gilgamesh's taunt, a straight blade Shirou has never seen turns its point toward him and is loaded for launch.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh aiming an unfamiliar straight sword becomes Shirou responding and pointing it toward himself.

contexts.japanese: ヤツの声に応じ、見たこともない直刀が切っ先を返す。
contexts.english: I respond to his voice, and a straight sword I've never seen before points towards me.

findings.description: Saber's arrival scattering Gilgamesh's projectiles becomes a gust merely intervening.
findings.sourceReading: The blue gust that cuts between the men knocks the launched Noble Phantasms away, establishing Saber's immediate defensive action.
findings.explanation: Saber's arrival scattering Gilgamesh's projectiles becomes a gust merely intervening.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちの間に割って入った、青い突風が蹴散らした。
contexts.english: A gust of blue wind intervenes between us.

findings.description: Saber postponing what she herself wants to tell Shirou becomes asking whether he has anything to tell her.
findings.sourceReading: After affirming him as her Master, Saber says she will discharge her Servant duty and tell him what she wants to say afterward.
findings.explanation: Saber postponing what she herself wants to tell Shirou becomes asking whether he has anything to tell her.

contexts.japanese: 伝えたい事は、その後に
contexts.english: If there is anything you want to tell me, we shall talk afterwards.

findings.description: Shirou's body swaying before he braces his right arm becomes turning.
findings.sourceReading: He sways, then grips his extended right arm with his left while staring at Gilgamesh.
findings.explanation: Shirou's body swaying before he braces his right arm becomes turning.

contexts.japanese: ゆらり、と。
contexts.english: I turn.

findings.description: Shirou’s left hand failing to move at all in the crucial instant becomes moving too slowly.
findings.sourceReading: Although he knew the fourth plate was falling, his left hand would not respond when he reflexively needed it.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s left hand failing to move at all in the crucial instant becomes moving too slowly.

contexts.japanese: 左手が咄嗟に動いてくれなかった。
contexts.english: my left hand didn't move fast enough.

findings.description: Rin’s challenging glare becomes treating Shirou as a challenge she must surmount.
findings.sourceReading: She glares with a confrontational, challenging attitude after realizing he lacks awareness.
findings.explanation: Rin’s challenging glare becomes treating Shirou as a challenge she must surmount.

contexts.japanese: 挑むような態度で、遠坂は睨んできた。
contexts.english: Tohsaka glares at me as if I'm a challenge to surmount.

findings.description: Rin offering to alter Shirou’s procedure for him becomes Shirou changing it himself.
findings.sourceReading: Rin considers that she may be able to make him immediately useful by changing the Projection procedure for him a little.
findings.explanation: Rin offering to alter Shirou’s procedure for him becomes Shirou changing it himself.

contexts.japanese: 少し手順を変えてあげるだけで
contexts.english: if you change your process a bit.

findings.description: Projection becoming an immediate combat asset becomes Shirou himself becoming useful.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says that if he can reproduce Archer’s swords, that capability will constitute immediately deployable fighting strength.
findings.explanation: Projection becoming an immediate combat asset becomes Shirou himself becoming useful.

contexts.japanese: 再現できれば即戦力じゃないっ！
contexts.english: you'll be useful right away if you just recreate that!

findings.description: Rin seeming to want Shirou to ask becomes seeming to want to ask him something.
findings.sourceReading: Sensing that she wants the opening, Shirou prompts her to say what the conversation is about.
findings.explanation: Rin seeming to want Shirou to ask becomes seeming to want to ask him something.

contexts.japanese: なんとなく聞かれたがってるな
contexts.english: I felt like she wanted to ask me something

findings.description: Rin presenting her inference as obvious becomes Shirou endorsing it as the natural conclusion.
findings.sourceReading: Rin assumes that Shirou must also have enjoyed training; the narration marks her manner as taking that conclusion for granted before Shirou cannot agree.
findings.explanation: Rin presenting her inference as obvious becomes Shirou endorsing it as the natural conclusion.

contexts.japanese: 当然のように遠坂は言う。
contexts.english: I suppose that would be the natural conclusion.

findings.description: Rin’s fingernail touching Shirou’s nose becomes digging into it.
findings.sourceReading: She crowds him so closely that the nail at the end of her pointing finger touches the tip of his nose.
findings.explanation: Rin’s fingernail touching Shirou’s nose becomes digging into it.

contexts.japanese: 爪がこう、鼻の頭に触れてる
contexts.english: her nail is digging into the tip of my nose!

findings.description: The English gives Saber the action of setting down tea that Shirou serves to her, removing a small act of care beside his protective words.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou places after-meal tea before Saber after telling her not to risk using her Noble Phantasm.
findings.explanation: The English gives Saber the action of setting down tea that Shirou serves to her, removing a small act of care beside his protective words.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの前に食後のお茶を置く。
contexts.english: Saber sets her tea down.

findings.description: Shirou asks Sakura to fetch Taiga; the English asks her to deliver the lunch. The final handoff is not established here.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou asks Sakura to bring Taiga over.
findings.explanation: Shirou asks Sakura to fetch Taiga; the English asks her to deliver the lunch. The final handoff is not established here.

contexts.japanese: あそこで無茶苦茶言ってる教師を連れてきてくれ
contexts.english: can you take this to that manic teacher over there?

findings.description: Sakura and Taiga’s simultaneous identical exclamation is presented as one ordinary speaker’s “What?”
findings.sourceReading: Both women react at exactly the same instant with exactly the same startled sound.
findings.explanation: Sakura and Taiga’s simultaneous identical exclamation is presented as one ordinary speaker’s “What?”

contexts.english: "...What?"

findings.description: Sakura's braced determination becomes enthusiasm. The physical tension is lost, but these pages do not establish exactly what she is preparing herself for.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou wonders why Sakura responds to the sleepover invitation with such tense, braced determination.
findings.explanation: Sakura's braced determination becomes enthusiasm. The physical tension is lost, but these pages do not establish exactly what she is preparing herself for.

contexts.japanese: どうしてそこで、そう力んで構えるのか桜。
contexts.english: Why are you so enthusiastic about it, Sakura?

findings.description: The pervasive transfer of blood’s iron smell without meaningful contact becomes a deliberate effort that mostly avoided contact, and the coat becomes Rin generally.
findings.sourceReading: She had not particularly touched anything, yet the rusty-iron smell had transferred to her coat.
findings.explanation: The pervasive transfer of blood’s iron smell without meaningful contact becomes a deliberate effort that mostly avoided contact, and the coat becomes Rin generally.

contexts.japanese: 特別触れたワケではないが、彼女のコートには錆びた鉄の匂いが移っていた
contexts.english: Though she was careful not to touch things for the most part, the scent of rust still made it onto her.

findings.description: The stealth movement becomes a sentence in which Shirou’s hand grammatically performs the tiptoeing.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou suppresses his footsteps and puts his hand on his room’s sliding door.
findings.explanation: The stealth movement becomes a sentence in which Shirou’s hand grammatically performs the tiptoeing.

contexts.japanese: 足音を殺して部屋の襖に手をかけた
contexts.english: My hand goes to the door to slide it open and tiptoe by

findings.description: Fuji-nee and the others sleeping in the sitting room become Fuji-nee alone.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou moves quietly so the sleeping group—Fuji-nee, Saber, and Sakura—will not notice him.
findings.explanation: Fuji-nee and the others sleeping in the sitting room become Fuji-nee alone.

contexts.japanese: 座敷で眠っている藤ねえたちに気づかれないよう
contexts.english: so Fuji-nee doesn't hear anything.

findings.description: The rattle of Rin’s suitcase wheels becomes the sound of passing cars.
findings.sourceReading: As she walks, her bag’s wheels clatter while she squints into the sea breeze.
findings.explanation: The rattle of Rin’s suitcase wheels becomes the sound of passing cars.

contexts.japanese: 車輪をガラガラと鳴らしながら
contexts.english: listening to cars go by.

findings.description: Rin’s inquiry about Rider’s postwar condition becomes a question about an unidentified male, and Rider continues answering about “he.”
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks Rider how her condition has been since the war; Rider says it is more stable than two years ago and that Sakura learned how to maintain it.
findings.explanation: Rin’s inquiry about Rider’s postwar condition becomes a question about an unidentified male, and Rider continues answering about “he.”

contexts.japanese: あれから調子はどう？
contexts.english: How's he doing?

contexts.japanese: 二年前に比べれば安定しています
contexts.english: he's more stable than he was two years ago.

findings.description: Rin’s decision that she need not be tactful too becomes a claim that Taiga need not worry about them.
findings.sourceReading: Rin appreciates Taiga’s consideration but decides she herself does not also need to tread carefully.
findings.explanation: Rin’s decision that she need not be tactful too becomes a claim that Taiga need not worry about them.

contexts.japanese: こっちまで気を遣うコトない
contexts.english: She doesn't need to worry about us

findings.description: People who actually came to Rin’s trial become people she was told would come after it.
findings.sourceReading: Department heads arrive, and unaffiliated mages gather in person to seize interests after the Tohsaka judgment; the crowd makes the trial a parade.
findings.explanation: People who actually came to Rin’s trial become people she was told would come after it.

contexts.japanese: 各部門長はやってくるわ遠坂家が裁かれたあとの利権拾いに来たはぐれ魔術師は集まるわ
contexts.english: They told me how the Lords of each department would come, how stray mages would come to pick up the pieces of the Tohsaka after my sentencing

findings.description: The statement that both Rin and Sakura survived becomes Rin alone surviving.
findings.sourceReading: Rider carries Rin and Sakura to the surface, enabling both sisters to live.
findings.explanation: The statement that both Rin and Sakura survived becomes Rin alone surviving.

contexts.japanese: わたしと桜は、なんとか生き延びる事が出来た
contexts.english: I survived, thanks to Rider carrying me and Sakura to the surface.

findings.description: Rider replenishing Rin’s magical energy becomes Rin replenishing it herself at home.
findings.sourceReading: Rider takes Rin to the Tohsaka mansion and supplies the magical energy that lets the Crest preserve her life.
findings.explanation: Rider replenishing Rin’s magical energy becomes Rin replenishing it herself at home.

contexts.japanese: ライダーはわたしを遠坂邸まで連れて行ってくれて、魔力を補充してくれた
contexts.english: Rider took me back to the Tohsaka house, where I replenished my magical energy.

findings.description: Shirou not needing help from either sister becomes Sakura not needing Rin’s help.
findings.sourceReading: Rin thinks Shirou probably never needed assistance from her or Sakura, though her school paperwork and excuses were useful.
findings.explanation: Shirou not needing help from either sister becomes Sakura not needing Rin’s help.

contexts.japanese: 元からわたしや桜の助けなんていらなかっただろうけど
contexts.english: Sakura never needed my help to begin with

findings.description: Sakura’s last image of Shirou and her certainty she can never meet him again become seeing “someone,” followed by “they” never meeting.
findings.sourceReading: She remembers his destroyed body and understands that she herself will never see him again.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s last image of Shirou and her certainty she can never meet him again become seeing “someone,” followed by “they” never meeting.

contexts.japanese: 最後に見たあの人の姿
contexts.english: I saw someone at the end.

contexts.japanese: もう、二度と会えない
contexts.english: they would never meet again

findings.description: Shirou’s insistence that he must be the one to ask Sakura for help becomes “you can’t ask me for help.”
findings.sourceReading: Because he will impose on Sakura, he restarts and properly makes the request himself.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s insistence that he must be the one to ask Sakura for help becomes “you can’t ask me for help.”

contexts.japanese: 俺の方からお願いしなくちゃダメだ
contexts.english: you can't ask me for help.

findings.description: Sakura fears what will happen when Rin goes home; the English says when Rin comes home.
findings.sourceReading: Even today Sakura doubts she can endure being alone after her sister leaves.
findings.explanation: Sakura fears what will happen when Rin goes home; the English says when Rin comes home.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんが帰ってしまったらどうなるか
contexts.english: what will happen if she comes home.

findings.description: Sakura reacting to seeing Shirou and Rin together becomes reacting to Shirou alone.
findings.sourceReading: 俺たち refers to the pair; the next dialogue explicitly addresses their being together.
findings.explanation: Sakura reacting to seeing Shirou and Rin together becomes reacting to Shirou alone.

contexts.japanese: 桜は俺たちを見るなり
contexts.english: As soon as she sees me

findings.description: Sakura’s lack of practice this morning becomes cancellation of morning practices generally.
findings.sourceReading: Their later commute lets Shirou encounter more students because Sakura is not going to morning practice.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s lack of practice this morning becomes cancellation of morning practices generally.

contexts.japanese: 朝練がない為か
contexts.english: possibly because morning practices are cancelled.

findings.description: Rin identifying herself as information provider becomes identifying Shirou as one of her sources.
findings.sourceReading: She claims she merely wants the outcome as the person who supplied the intelligence.
findings.explanation: Rin identifying herself as information provider becomes identifying Shirou as one of her sources.

contexts.japanese: 情報提供者として事の顛末が知りたいだけ
contexts.english: what happened to one of my intel sources!

findings.description: Rin who possesses Archer becomes Archer himself.
findings.sourceReading: アーチャーを有する modifies 遠坂, the second person unaware.
findings.explanation: Rin who possesses Archer becomes Archer himself.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーを有する遠坂
contexts.english: Tohsaka's Archer

findings.description: Shirou's wariness of Kotomine becomes confidence in Kotomine's carefulness. The English substitutes a judgment of competence for the source's warning about dealing with him.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine was someone around whom Shirou could not safely lower his guard.
findings.explanation: Shirou's wariness of Kotomine becomes confidence in Kotomine's carefulness. The English substitutes a judgment of competence for the source's warning about dealing with him.

contexts.japanese: 油断ならなかった言峰
contexts.english: I know he wouldn't be careless.

findings.description: Illya’s promise becomes Shirou’s promise.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou reports that Illya herself promised to do nothing.
findings.explanation: Illya’s promise becomes Shirou’s promise.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは何もしないって約束した
contexts.english: I can promise that Illya won't do anything.

findings.description: Illya’s qualified approval and Shirou keeping her company become a customary serving of well-regarded sweets.
findings.sourceReading: The sweets seem moderately well received, so he will go on accompanying her normally.
findings.explanation: Illya’s qualified approval and Shirou keeping her company become a customary serving of well-regarded sweets.

contexts.japanese: 微妙に好評のようだし、こっちもいつも通り付き合おう
contexts.english: that we always have with tea.

findings.description: Shirou’s idea to fulfill Illya’s wish becomes second-person advice to fulfill your wish.
findings.sourceReading: 俺 thinks he could respond to イリヤの望み through the Command Spell analogy.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s idea to fulfill Illya’s wish becomes second-person advice to fulfill your wish.

contexts.japanese: 令呪でイリヤの望みに応える
contexts.english: use your Command Spells to make your wish come true?

findings.description: Not questioning her trivial-seeming request in the face of her courage becomes not doubting the courage itself.
findings.sourceReading: Her courageous disclosure makes his petty objections inappropriate.
findings.explanation: Not questioning her trivial-seeming request in the face of her courage becomes not doubting the courage itself.

contexts.japanese: そのありったけの勇気に、つまらない疑問なんて挟める筈がない
contexts.english: I shouldn't keep doubting her courage.

findings.description: The two drinks Illya carries become two drinks she bought.
findings.sourceReading: The passage says she has both cans; page29 explicitly says her own can is the purchase she asked Shirou to make.
findings.explanation: The two drinks Illya carries become two drinks she bought.

contexts.japanese: 二人分のジュースを持って
contexts.english: the two drinks she bought.

findings.description: Shirou's description of himself as the unrelated child who became Kiritsugu's son is reassigned to Illya. His reflection on following his adoptive father is lost.
findings.sourceReading: The child is Shirou: originally unrelated to Kiritsugu, he followed his example as his son.
findings.explanation: Shirou's description of himself as the unrelated child who became Kiritsugu's son is reassigned to Illya. His reflection on following his adoptive father is lost.

contexts.japanese: 切嗣の息子として、その背中を追い続けた無縁の子供
contexts.english: From the perspective of Kiritsugu's son, she's a child who's been chasing after a man who has nothing to do with her.

findings.description: Leaving before Shirou can stop her becomes leaving without a second thought.
findings.sourceReading: 止める間もなく concerns the lack of time to intervene.
findings.explanation: Leaving before Shirou can stop her becomes leaving without a second thought.

contexts.japanese: 止める間もなく走り去っていく
contexts.english: She runs away without a second thought.

findings.description: Shirou's prediction that Zouken will intervene becomes a declaration that Shirou himself cannot stand aside. Zouken's anticipated initiative disappears from this sentence.
findings.sourceReading: The blood-feeding monster who sought the Grail through Shinji cannot be expected to remain a passive spectator.
findings.explanation: Shirou's prediction that Zouken will intervene becomes a declaration that Shirou himself cannot stand aside. Zouken's anticipated initiative disappears from this sentence.

contexts.japanese: そんなヤツが、大人しくこの戦いを傍観する訳がないんだから
contexts.english: I can't just stand aside and let this fight play out.

findings.description: Rin's report that the strange entity vanished becomes a report that Shirou vanished. The Japanese exchange concerns what happened to the entity after he collapsed.
findings.sourceReading: Answering Shirou's question about the strange entity, Rin says it disappeared as he stood on its shadow and collapsed.
findings.explanation: Rin's report that the strange entity vanished becomes a report that Shirou vanished. The Japanese exchange concerns what happened to the entity after he collapsed.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮くんが影の上に立って、倒れたと思ったらもういなかった
contexts.english: You stepped on the shadow, and I thought you fell, but you were just gone.

findings.description: Archer’s self-correction about cleanup versus prevention becomes advice about Shirou’s prospects and surviving.
findings.sourceReading: He reconsiders his own preceding fatalism: this time the event has not occurred and prevention remains possible.
findings.explanation: Archer’s self-correction about cleanup versus prevention becomes advice about Shirou’s prospects and surviving.

contexts.japanese: 後始末に留まるか、その前にカタをつけるのか
contexts.english: Will you survive and clean up the aftermath, or nip this in the bud?

findings.description: Taiga's report of an apparent school policy becomes a decision she personally made. The English adds authority and certainty that her wording does not claim.
findings.sourceReading: Taiga reports that the apparent policy is to minimize students' burdens, in a discussion of injuries extending beyond her own club.
findings.explanation: Taiga's report of an apparent school policy becomes a decision she personally made. The English adds authority and certainty that her wording does not claim.

contexts.japanese: できるだけ生徒には負担をかけない方針でいくみたい
contexts.english: I made the decision not to stress them out any more than necessary.

findings.description: Rin accepting being used becomes inability to stop others taking advantage of the war.
findings.sourceReading: 誰かに利用されるのは仕方ない permits being used herself; the objection is acting without knowing whom she harms and how.
findings.explanation: Rin accepting being used becomes inability to stop others taking advantage of the war.

contexts.japanese: 誰かに利用されるのは仕方ないけど
contexts.english: I can't stop someone else from taking advantage of it

findings.description: The training being only a beginning becomes Shirou still being a beginner.
findings.sourceReading: 稽古はまだ序の口 asks whether yesterday and today’s exercises were only the opening stage of the regimen.
findings.explanation: The training being only a beginning becomes Shirou still being a beginner.

contexts.japanese: 昨日と今日の稽古はまだ序の口だったのかな
contexts.english: Are you saying I'm still a beginner after training for the last couple days?

findings.description: Her estranged sense that events concern someone else becomes asking whether nobody cares.
findings.sourceReading: 他人事のよう describes her dissociated experience in the imitation-like deserted city.
findings.explanation: Her estranged sense that events concern someone else becomes asking whether nobody cares.

contexts.japanese: こんなにも、他人事のようなのか
contexts.english: Does no one really care?

findings.description: Shirou’s alternative explanation becomes a question about Rin’s explanation.
findings.sourceReading: He acknowledges her argument but proposes Zouken’s confidence in Assassin as an alternative.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s alternative explanation becomes a question about Rin’s explanation.

contexts.japanese: アサシンがセイバーを必ず倒せるって自信があったんじゃないか
contexts.english: are you saying that

findings.description: Permission to take Sakura away becomes Shinji’s promise to bring her.
findings.sourceReading: If Shirou comes alone, he may take Sakura as she is and leave with her.
findings.explanation: Permission to take Sakura away becomes Shinji’s promise to bring her.

contexts.japanese: 一人で迎えに来るなら桜はそのまま連れて行っていい
contexts.english: I'll bring Sakura if you come alone.

findings.description: Rider's acknowledgment that she underestimated Shirou becomes an admission that she lost focus. This removes her recognition of his successful concentration.
findings.sourceReading: Rider apologizes for underestimating Shirou's concentration after he predicts her attacks and briefly passes her.
findings.explanation: Rider's acknowledgment that she underestimated Shirou becomes an admission that she lost focus. This removes her recognition of his successful concentration.

contexts.japanese: 少々、彼の集中力を侮っていました
contexts.english: I lost focus for a moment.

findings.description: Shirou’s uncertain remembered gloss of shiniku becomes an explanation Rin gave him.
findings.sourceReading: だったっけか marks his private recollection; Rin only compares the practice material to shiniku.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertain remembered gloss of shiniku becomes an explanation Rin gave him.

contexts.japanese: 中国に伝わる幾ら食べても減らない肉、だったっけか
contexts.english: she said a shiniku is a lump of meat

findings.description: Being taught incorrectly becomes Shirou’s way of thinking being incorrect.
findings.sourceReading: 教え方が間違えられていた assigns the problem to faulty instruction, after questions about his teacher.
findings.explanation: Being taught incorrectly becomes Shirou’s way of thinking being incorrect.

contexts.japanese: 貴方の場合は教え方が間違えられていた
contexts.english: your way of thinking is incorrect.

findings.description: Zouken’s reported explanation for Sakura’s condition is omitted.
findings.sourceReading: 爺さんの言ってた通り attributes the Rider-overuse account to their grandfather.
findings.explanation: Zouken’s reported explanation for Sakura’s condition is omitted.

contexts.japanese: こりゃ爺さんの言ってた通り、ライダーを使いすぎた反動かな
contexts.english: This must be the drawback from overusing Rider.

findings.description: Rider's grip on Shinji's arm becomes Shinji clinging to hers. Her verbal refusal to let him hurt Sakura remains, but the physical expression of that refusal changes.
findings.sourceReading: After Rider releases him, Shinji holds his own arm where she had seized it and staggers backward.
findings.explanation: Rider's grip on Shinji's arm becomes Shinji clinging to hers. Her verbal refusal to let him hurt Sakura remains, but the physical expression of that refusal changes.

contexts.japanese: ライダーに掴まれた腕を押さえながら
contexts.english: Shinji, who had been clinging to her arm.

findings.description: Shinji having no remaining chance becomes Sakura not caring about him.
findings.sourceReading: アンタにもう目はない denies prospects of becoming a Master, alongside her refusal to fight.
findings.explanation: Shinji having no remaining chance becomes Sakura not caring about him.

contexts.japanese: アンタにもう目はない
contexts.english: she doesn't care about you.

findings.description: Rider briefly stopping at Sakura’s voice becomes Shirou noticing movement behind Rider.
findings.sourceReading: The continuing subject Rider halts slightly because of the voice from behind her.
findings.explanation: Rider briefly stopping at Sakura’s voice becomes Shirou noticing movement behind Rider.

contexts.japanese: 背後からの声で、わずかに動きを止めていた
contexts.english: I notice a slight movement behind her.

findings.description: Seeing Rider with physical or mental vision becomes everything she sees, physical or spiritual, being cursed.
findings.sourceReading: 肉眼/心眼 describe the observer’s means of seeing her; 今の私を見る事自体 is the curse.
findings.explanation: Seeing Rider with physical or mental vision becomes everything she sees, physical or spiritual, being cursed.

contexts.japanese: 肉眼であろうが心眼であろうが、今の私を見る事自体が呪い
contexts.english: Everything I see is cursed, whether physical or spiritual.

findings.description: The attack on Shirou becomes the attack on Rin.
findings.sourceReading: 俺を襲った belongs to the no-rescue-shove variant, after the wave turns and strikes him.
findings.explanation: The attack on Shirou becomes the attack on Rin.

contexts.japanese: 俺を襲った槍のようなもの
contexts.english: The spear-like thing that attacked Tohsaka

findings.description: Illya walking around and happening upon Shirou becomes seeing him walking and having come all the way to meet him.
findings.sourceReading: 町を歩いてたら is Illya’s account of her walk; せっかく会えた expresses the precious chance to meet.
findings.explanation: Illya walking around and happening upon Shirou becomes seeing him walking and having come all the way to meet him.

contexts.japanese: 町を歩いてたらシロウがいたから
contexts.english: I saw you walking around town

contexts.japanese: せっかく会えたのに、それじゃつまんない
contexts.english: I came all the way here to see you.

findings.description: Shirou driving Illya away for his own relief becomes Illya trying to make him feel better.
findings.sourceReading: 自分が楽になりたくて describes the selfish motive he condemns in himself.
findings.explanation: Shirou driving Illya away for his own relief becomes Illya trying to make him feel better.

contexts.japanese: 自分が楽になりたくてイリヤを追い払っている
contexts.english: Illya's just trying to make me feel better, but I'm pushing her away.

findings.description: Illya being betrayed a second time becomes Shirou having betrayed her twice.
findings.sourceReading: The first betrayal belongs to Kiritsugu, the second to Shirou's repetition of that choice; イリヤは is the victim subject.
findings.explanation: Illya being betrayed a second time becomes Shirou having betrayed her twice.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはこれで二度裏切られた
contexts.english: This marks the second time I've betrayed Illya.

findings.description: Rin affirming she will reach a conclusion becomes asserting Sakura already committed wrong.
findings.sourceReading: 出すわよ answers なに勝手に結論出してんだ; it is Rin's conclusion, not Sakura's past offense.
findings.explanation: Rin affirming she will reach a conclusion becomes asserting Sakura already committed wrong.

contexts.japanese: 出すわよ！
contexts.english: She already has!

findings.description: Shirou excluding death-as-salvation from his agreement becomes denying that Rin says it.
findings.sourceReading: 死が救いになる、という事ではなく limits Shirou's own assessment: correct in saving lives, not in death being salvation.
findings.explanation: Shirou excluding death-as-salvation from his agreement becomes denying that Rin says it.

contexts.japanese: 死が救いになる、という事ではなく
contexts.english: She isn't saying that death would save Sakura

findings.description: Sakura not releasing the embrace becomes Shirou not stopping it.
findings.sourceReading: 桜は抱きとめた腕を振り解かない is her choice not to shake off his arms, preceding her wish to remain.
findings.explanation: Sakura not releasing the embrace becomes Shirou not stopping it.

contexts.japanese: 桜は抱きとめた腕を振り解かない
contexts.english: I don't stop hugging her.

findings.description: The worms craving a mage's power becomes Sakura wanting power as a mage.
findings.sourceReading: 身体の虫たちが is the subject of 欲しくて and 疼き出す; the next sentence explicitly reiterates the worms' hunger.
findings.explanation: The worms craving a mage's power becomes Sakura wanting power as a mage.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師の力が欲しくて、身体の虫たちが疼き出す
contexts.english: When I want power as a mage, the worms in my body start to twinge.

findings.description: Refusing the one help he can give becomes hating him for that help.
findings.sourceReading: してやれる唯一のことを嫌がられたら is aversion to the offered act itself.
findings.explanation: Refusing the one help he can give becomes hating him for that help.

contexts.japanese: 俺にしてやれる唯一のことを嫌がられたら
contexts.english: if you hated me for the one thing I can do to help you.

findings.description: Both creation and collapse being catharsis becomes catharsis for both participants.
findings.sourceReading: どちらも refers to the two processes in the immediately preceding sentence, not Shirou and Sakura.
findings.explanation: Both creation and collapse being catharsis becomes catharsis for both participants.

contexts.japanese: どちらもカタルシスには違いない
contexts.english: It's cathartic for both sides.

findings.description: Tentative recollection of shiniku becomes a definite explanation previously given by Rin.
findings.sourceReading: だったっけか is Shirou checking his own recollection; the source does not attribute this definition to Rin.
findings.explanation: Tentative recollection of shiniku becomes a definite explanation previously given by Rin.

contexts.japanese: 中国に伝わる幾ら食べても減らない肉、だったっけか
contexts.english: she said a shiniku is a lump of meat

findings.description: Shirou’s most plausible fear becomes Rin’s most likely concern.
findings.sourceReading: He asks the worry he thinks most likely, namely that she regrets teaming up with him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s most plausible fear becomes Rin’s most likely concern.

contexts.japanese: 一番ありえそうな不安
contexts.english: her most likely concern.

findings.description: Shinji's boast that he would win becomes an admission that Shirou would win. This changes the self-serving argument with which he sends Rider against Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji claims that he himself would certainly win an ordinary fight, before presenting combat against Rider as fair.
findings.explanation: Shinji's boast that he would win becomes an admission that Shirou would win. This changes the self-serving argument with which he sends Rider against Shirou.

contexts.japanese: ただのケンカじゃ僕が勝つ
contexts.english: we know you'd win in a fistfight.

findings.description: Deliberately pulling Rider’s arm to reverse positions becomes pulling himself up on her arms.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女の腕を引いて、あからさまに立ち位置を逆にした explicitly locates his tactical action and Shinji’s failure to notice it.
findings.explanation: Shirou pulls Rider’s arm to reverse their positions. The English instead has him pull himself up using her arms; it keeps the reversed positions but changes the movement that produces them.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の腕を引いて、あからさまに立ち位置を逆にした
contexts.english: our positions are reversed since I pulled myself up using Rider's arms?

findings.description: Shirou’s known Three Corpses lore is attributed to Kirei explaining it.
findings.sourceReading: Narration states the legend Shirou recalls, then says he has heard of that but not Crest Worms.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s known Three Corpses lore is attributed to Kirei explaining it.

contexts.japanese: 三尸—人間の体に棲み
contexts.english: He explains that the Three Corpses

findings.description: A warning that even the original practitioner could not undo the implantation becomes a claim about Kotomine's training and personal limits. This changes the scope and basis of his medical explanation.
findings.sourceReading: Even the practitioner who implanted the Crest could presumably no longer undo it now that the worms are part of Sakura.
findings.explanation: A warning that even the original practitioner could not undo the implantation becomes a claim about Kotomine's training and personal limits. This changes the scope and basis of his medical explanation.

contexts.japanese: 刻印を植え付けた術者本人でさえ
contexts.english: I am trained in Crest transplantation

findings.description: The imposed cross-burden becomes the cross God/Christ bore.
findings.sourceReading: 科せられた十字 is the imposed cross under the guilt Shirou has just internalized; no He-bearing clause is supplied.
findings.explanation: The imposed cross-burden becomes the cross God/Christ bore.

contexts.japanese: 科せられた十字
contexts.english: the cross He bore.

findings.description: Another more suitable person being beside Shirou becomes Sakura working to become suitable.
findings.sourceReading: 彼の隣に座るのは、もっと相応しい人でなくてはいけない follows her excluding herself; she waits beside him only until that other person arrives.
findings.explanation: Another more suitable person being beside Shirou becomes Sakura working to become suitable.

contexts.japanese: もっと相応しい人でなくてはいけない
contexts.english: she would work to become someone good enough

findings.description: Rin removing everything from Sakura becomes those things independently disappearing.
findings.sourceReading: 姉さんは全てを手に入れる governs 消していく, preserving Sakura’s resentful perception of her sister’s agency.
findings.explanation: Rin removing everything from Sakura becomes those things independently disappearing.

contexts.japanese: わたしの前から消していく
contexts.english: are all going to disappear...

findings.description: Taiga’s prior insult becomes the pupil’s insult spoken in front of Taiga.
findings.sourceReading: タイガ、前に言ったじゃない directly addresses Taiga as the prior speaker; her next reply is uncertain recollection of having said it herself.
findings.explanation: Taiga’s prior insult becomes the pupil’s insult spoken in front of Taiga.

contexts.japanese: タイガ前に言ったじゃない
contexts.english: Remember when I said in front of you

contexts.japanese: 言ったような言わないような
contexts.english: You did? Maybe, maybe not...

findings.description: Rin being spotted walking becomes suddenly strolling right up to him.
findings.sourceReading: 歩いていた describes the convenient person he sees already walking; she stops and calls to him on the next page.
findings.explanation: Rin being spotted walking becomes suddenly strolling right up to him.

contexts.japanese: ひょこひょこと歩いていた
contexts.english: suddenly strolls right up to me.

findings.description: Shaking off the voice behind him becomes turning to look back at it.
findings.sourceReading: 振り切って means escaping despite her call, while continuing into the corridor.
findings.explanation: Shaking off the voice behind him becomes turning to look back at it.

contexts.japanese: 背中にかかるあくまの声を振り切って
contexts.english: turning to look back at the devil's voice

findings.description: Feeling events are sliding toward a worse outcome becomes seeing Rin build up more anger.
findings.sourceReading: より悪い方へ転がっていく気がする is his tentative evaluation of his decision’s consequences.
findings.explanation: Feeling events are sliding toward a worse outcome becomes seeing Rin build up more anger.

contexts.japanese: より悪い方へ転がっていく気がする
contexts.english: She looks like she's still gathering steam

findings.description: Eating with the boys and arguing on the return becomes a solitary account of eating and grumbling.
findings.sourceReading: 男連中と完食し and 口論しながら戻ってきた retain participation and reciprocal debate over even shrimp tasting of meat.
findings.explanation: Eating with the boys and arguing on the return becomes a solitary account of eating and grumbling.

contexts.japanese: 男連中と肉の味がするミックス定食を完食し
contexts.english: I have the combo meal that some of my classmates went on about.

contexts.japanese: 口論しながら戻ってきた
contexts.english: I grumble about it as I go back to my classroom.

findings.description: Rin rushing up and shouting becomes her anger at Shirou for getting close.
findings.sourceReading: ここまで突進してきて怒鳴る assigns the movement to Rin; Shirou remains at the woodland entrance and then she retreats.
findings.explanation: Rin rushing up and shouting becomes her anger at Shirou for getting close.

contexts.japanese: ここまで突進してきて怒鳴る
contexts.english: She's pissed at me for getting even this close.

findings.description: Rin’s embarrassing shout becomes Shirou having embarrassed her by his shouting.
findings.sourceReading: 大声出したの follows her five-echo shout and his observation it reached the archery hall.
findings.explanation: Rin’s embarrassing shout becomes Shirou having embarrassed her by his shouting.

contexts.japanese: 大声出したの、そんなに恥ずかしかった
contexts.english: Did I embarrass you that much by yelling?

findings.description: Shirou normally feeling nervous alone with Rin becomes others being thrilled.
findings.sourceReading: 本来なら緊張する is his own usual expected reaction in this private situation.
findings.explanation: Shirou normally feeling nervous alone with Rin becomes others being thrilled.

contexts.japanese: 本来なら遠坂と二人だけ、という状況に緊張する
contexts.english: others would be thrilled to be alone with Tohsaka

findings.description: Shirou glaring at Illya while holding shopping becomes Illya looking at his shopping bag.
