findings.sourceReading: ビニール袋を手に describes Shirou; 睨みつける assigns his glare toward Illya, who only looks back curiously.
findings.explanation: Shirou glaring at Illya while holding shopping becomes Illya looking at his shopping bag.

contexts.japanese: ビニール袋を手に、キッとイリヤを睨みつける
contexts.english: Illya shoots a glance at the shopping bag in my hand.

findings.description: Illya avoiding being disliked becomes a general aversion to forcing people.
findings.sourceReading: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃうから locates the feared consequence in other people disliking her.
findings.explanation: Illya avoiding being disliked becomes a general aversion to forcing people.

contexts.japanese: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃうから
contexts.english: I don't like forcing people to do things.

findings.description: Dropping the school from surveillance becomes dropping Shinji from a list of people.
findings.sourceReading: 学校はいつも通り leads to 外していい and the explicit narration confirms his report is no Master at school.
findings.explanation: Dropping the school from surveillance becomes dropping Shinji from a list of people.

contexts.japanese: 見て回るべき対象から外していい
contexts.english: cross him off our list of people to watch

findings.description: Shirou addressing Taiga behind him becomes hearing Taiga behind him.
findings.sourceReading: 声をかける assigns the speech to Shirou, following his quoted excuse.
findings.explanation: Shirou addressing Taiga behind him becomes hearing Taiga behind him.

contexts.japanese: 背後の藤ねえに声をかける
contexts.english: I hear Fuji-nee from behind me.

findings.description: Sakura receiving a rook handicap and still losing becomes giving Taiga a handicap herself.
findings.sourceReading: ハンデもらってもこてんぱん means even if Taiga removes her rook to help Sakura, Sakura is still thoroughly defeated.
findings.explanation: Sakura receiving a rook handicap and still losing becomes giving Taiga a handicap herself.

contexts.japanese: 飛車抜きのハンデもらってもこてんぱん
contexts.english: if I give her a handicap and play without rooks.

findings.description: Having young household members procure clothes becomes gathering younger-looking clothes.
findings.sourceReading: うちの若いのに揃えさせておく uses the people as recipients of the causative instruction to assemble the needed items.
findings.explanation: Having young household members procure clothes becomes gathering younger-looking clothes.

contexts.japanese: うちの若いのに揃えさせておく
contexts.english: I'll gather up my younger-looking clothes

findings.description: Taiga's instruction that Shirou provide fresh sheets becomes her promise to bring them, shifting one part of Sakura's care from him to her.
findings.sourceReading: Taiga tells Shirou to prepare Sakura's room and make sure to put out fresh sheets while she handles clothes.
findings.explanation: Taiga's instruction that Shirou provide fresh sheets becomes her promise to bring them, shifting one part of Sakura's care from him to her.

contexts.japanese: シーツとか、ちゃんと新しいの出してあげるのよ
contexts.english: I'll bring some new sheets.

findings.description: Sakura having no need to worry over the old incident becomes Shirou denying attraction.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が気にする事でもない locates unnecessary concern in Sakura after he recounts her guilt-related assistance.
findings.explanation: Sakura having no need to worry over the old incident becomes Shirou denying attraction.

contexts.japanese: 桜が気にする事でもないのに
contexts.english: It's not like I see her that way.

findings.description: Being unsteadily drawn toward the scene becomes the predator draining its prey.
findings.sourceReading: ふらふらと吸い寄せられる is passive attraction, continuing the narrator’s movement into the classroom before his attempt to rescue Mitsuzuri.
findings.explanation: Being unsteadily drawn toward the scene becomes the predator draining its prey.

contexts.japanese: ふらふらと吸い寄せられる
contexts.english: It giddily drains its prey of life.

findings.description: Mitsuzuri’s nonresisting exposed throat becomes the predator actively exposing it.
findings.sourceReading: 無抵抗の美綴が ... 晒していた makes the unresisting victim the subject of the throat presentation.
findings.explanation: Mitsuzuri’s nonresisting exposed throat becomes the predator actively exposing it.

contexts.japanese: 無抵抗の美綴が、白い喉を遠坂の前に晒していた
contexts.english: She exposes Mitsuzuri's defenseless, pale throat.

findings.description: Shirou rejecting apparent appeasement becomes Saber not being in the mood.
findings.sourceReading: ご機嫌をうかがっているようで嫌 locates reluctance in his own dislike of seeming to curry favor while they are fighting.
findings.explanation: Shirou rejecting apparent appeasement becomes Saber not being in the mood.

contexts.japanese: ご機嫌をうかがっているようで嫌
contexts.english: she didn't look like she was in the mood

findings.description: Saber's possible reasons for attacking become possible reasons for Caster's silence, introducing the suggestion that Caster has been caught red-handed.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator wonders whether Saber takes Caster's failure to react as an opportunity or an insult, immediately before describing Saber's advance.
findings.explanation: Saber's possible reasons for attacking become possible reasons for Caster's silence, introducing the suggestion that Caster has been caught red-handed.

contexts.japanese: 好機と取ったのか、侮辱と取ったのか
contexts.english: because we've caught her by surprise, or because she was caught red-handed?

findings.description: The swamp consuming the body and its red bloodstain becomes the swamp’s red mass spreading to consume the body.
findings.sourceReading: 男の動かぬ身体と粘つく紅い染み are the paired objects being swallowed by the floor.
findings.explanation: The swamp consuming the body and its red bloodstain becomes the swamp’s red mass spreading to consume the body.

contexts.japanese: 男の動かぬ身体と粘つく紅い染みを平らげていく
contexts.english: its crimson mass spreading out to consume the man's unmoving body.

findings.description: A girl busying herself solely with chores becomes making her do chores.
findings.sourceReading: 年頃の女の子が家事手伝いばかりに奔走 is the girl’s ongoing self-driven activity that Shirou considers unhealthy.
findings.explanation: A girl busying herself solely with chores becomes making her do chores.

contexts.japanese: 女の子が家事手伝いばかりに奔走
contexts.english: make a girl her age constantly do house chores.

contexts.japanese: 女の子が家事手伝いばかりに奔走
contexts.english: make a girl her age constantly do house chores.

findings.description: Zouken's almost visible killing intent becomes hostility in the surrounding insects. His chuckle remains, but the direct description of his murderous intent is lost.
findings.sourceReading: The old insect-user laughs with killing intent so palpable that it seems visible.
findings.explanation: Zouken's almost visible killing intent becomes hostility in the surrounding insects. His chuckle remains, but the direct description of his murderous intent is lost.

contexts.japanese: 目に見えるほどの殺気を伴って笑う
contexts.english: the mass of hostile bugs.

findings.description: Inability to stop his momentum becomes deliberately preserving it.
findings.sourceReading: 勢いを殺せず describes failed braking as he tumbles out, subsequently hurting all over.
findings.explanation: Inability to stop his momentum becomes deliberately preserving it.

contexts.japanese: 勢いを殺せず
contexts.english: preserving my momentum.

findings.description: Shirou lifting feet off wet earth becomes the earth releasing his feet.
findings.sourceReading: 土から足を離す assigns the movement to him as he attempts a backward jump.
findings.explanation: Shirou lifting feet off wet earth becomes the earth releasing his feet.

contexts.japanese: 水気に満ちた土から足を離す
contexts.english: The moist ground lets go of my feet.

findings.description: Vaguely overhearing Sakura and Saber becomes remembering participating in their talk.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura and Saber were talking; Shirou thinks he heard them unclearly and asks what happened.
findings.explanation: Vaguely overhearing Sakura and Saber becomes remembering participating in their talk.

contexts.japanese: 桜とセイバーがなんか話してた気がする。……よく聞こえなかったんだけど、そん時なにかあったのか？
contexts.english: I remember talking with you and Saber about something.

findings.description: Sakura’s unfinished I, to Saber becomes Saber didn’t.
findings.sourceReading: わたし、セイバーさんに resumes Sakura’s guilt over her own words directed at Saber.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s unfinished I, to Saber becomes Saber didn’t.

contexts.japanese: わたし、セイバーさんに
contexts.english: Saber didn't—

findings.description: Saber’s question about herself and Sakura becomes a claim that Sakura thinks they fought.
findings.sourceReading: わたしと桜がケンカ、ですか restates Shirou’s question with surprise.
findings.explanation: Saber’s question about herself and Sakura becomes a claim that Sakura thinks they fought.

contexts.japanese: わたしと桜がケンカ、ですか
contexts.english: Sakura thinks we had a fight?

findings.description: Shirou and Sakura caring for each other becomes both caring for Saber.
findings.sourceReading: 二人とも互いを気遣って means the two act out of consideration for one another.
findings.explanation: Shirou and Sakura caring for each other becomes both caring for Saber.

contexts.japanese: 二人とも互いを気遣って
contexts.english: your mutual way of being considerate to me.

findings.description: Regret toward someone who has endured for over ten years becomes Rin bearing guilt for ten years.
findings.sourceReading: 十年以上も我慢し続けた modifies 誰か, the person toward whom Rin feels regret, following her wish to have come sooner.
findings.explanation: Regret toward someone who has endured for over ten years becomes Rin bearing guilt for ten years.

contexts.japanese: 十年以上も我慢し続けた、誰かに対する後悔だった
contexts.english: the guilt she's been bearing towards a certain someone for the last ten years.

findings.description: A saliva-wet tongue licking dry lips becomes a dry tongue licking spittle on his chin.
findings.sourceReading: 唾液にまみれた舌が、乾いた唇を舐め上げる assigns moisture to tongue, dryness to lips and the action to licking the lips.
findings.explanation: A saliva-wet tongue licking dry lips becomes a dry tongue licking spittle on his chin.

contexts.japanese: 唾液にまみれた舌が、乾いた唇を舐め上げる
contexts.english: His dry tongue licks up the spittle running down his chin.

findings.description: An ominous presence around Assassin becomes an aura explicitly coming from him. The Japanese leaves its source unspecified, consistent with the next warning about the darkness ahead.
findings.sourceReading: Saber senses something ominous around Assassin, without identifying him as its source. The next page warns against approaching the darkness.
findings.explanation: An ominous presence around Assassin becomes an aura explicitly coming from him. The Japanese leaves its source unspecified, consistent with the next warning about the darkness ahead.

contexts.japanese: アサシンの周囲に不吉な気配を感じる
contexts.english: the sinister aura plainly emanating from Assassin.

findings.description: Sakura responding to the boy before her becomes stepping in front of him.
findings.sourceReading: そんな俺を前にして describes her reaction facing him before returning the home greeting.
findings.explanation: Sakura responding to the boy before her becomes stepping in front of him.

contexts.japanese: そんな俺を前にして
contexts.english: Sakura steps in front of me.

findings.description: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: 奪い返した is taking back, with no expressed object or source-person in this sentence.
findings.explanation: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 奪い返したという事実
contexts.english: What she took from him.

findings.description: If he gets injuries preventing walking becomes I will hurt you so you cannot walk.
findings.sourceReading: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば imagines him being disabled as the solution but does not explicitly name who inflicts the injury.
findings.explanation: If he gets injuries preventing walking becomes I will hurt you so you cannot walk.

contexts.japanese: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば
contexts.english: If I hurt you so you can't walk anymore

findings.description: Kirei having kept Gilgamesh attached becomes Gilgamesh granting Kirei patronage, shifting the emphasis in their partnership.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh credits their shared objective with Kirei having kept him attached thus far.
findings.explanation: Kirei having kept Gilgamesh attached becomes Gilgamesh granting Kirei patronage, shifting the emphasis in their partnership.

contexts.japanese: 我をここまで繋ぎとめた
contexts.english: you have my patronage!

findings.description: Gilgamesh's announcement that he will act freely becomes permission for Kirei to do so.
findings.sourceReading: After accepting Kirei's inaction, Gilgamesh announces that he will act as he pleases and disappears.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh's announcement that he will act freely becomes permission for Kirei to do so.

contexts.japanese: せいぜい好きにさせてもらうぞ
contexts.english: Do as you please.

findings.description: The father's assurance that Shirou can go alone becomes the mother's order that the father must not go alone. Speaker, addressee, and instruction all change.
findings.sourceReading: His father asks or affirms that the child can go alone, then tells him to wait outside.
findings.explanation: The father's assurance that Shirou can go alone becomes the mother's order that the father must not go alone. Speaker, addressee, and instruction all change.

contexts.japanese: お父さんはひとりでいけるな、といった
contexts.english: She told Dad not to go on his own.

findings.description: Discoloring fingernails scratching his throat become nails scratching the throat red.
findings.sourceReading: 喉を掻き毟る爪が変色している makes the claws/nails the thing changing color in the heat.
findings.explanation: Discoloring fingernails scratching his throat become nails scratching the throat red.

contexts.japanese: 喉を掻き毟る爪が変色している
contexts.english: my nails scratching it red.

findings.description: Sweat-soaked nightclothes feeling unpleasant become a wish to prevent the sheets getting soaked.
findings.sourceReading: 寝巻きは汗を吸って気持ち悪い describes an already wet garment’s present discomfort.
findings.explanation: Sweat-soaked nightclothes feeling unpleasant become a wish to prevent the sheets getting soaked.

contexts.japanese: 寝巻きは汗を吸って気持ち悪い
contexts.english: I don't want my sheets to soak it up and get all gross

findings.description: Limbs wanting rest after a short walk gain breathlessness as the cause of collapse.
findings.sourceReading: 手足は休息を欲しがって describes bodily exhaustion despite only going to the veranda.
findings.explanation: Limbs wanting rest after a short walk gain breathlessness as the cause of collapse.

contexts.japanese: 手足は休息を欲しがってすぐに倒れてしまう
contexts.english: the effort made me so short of breath I collapsed right back into bed.

findings.description: Insisting he remain at rest becomes physically pushing him down.
findings.sourceReading: 駆けつけた桜に念を押される is Sakura rushing over to reinforce her verbal instruction.
findings.explanation: Insisting he remain at rest becomes physically pushing him down.

contexts.japanese: 駆けつけた桜に念を押されてしまった
contexts.english: Sakura rushes over and pushes me down.

findings.description: Sakura's explanation that she receives meals here becomes a promise to feed Shirou. Cleaning changes from reciprocating hospitality to another part of caring for him.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura describes receiving hospitality: she spends mornings here and gets to eat dinner here, so cleaning is a reasonable contribution.
findings.explanation: Sakura's explanation that she receives meals here becomes a promise to feed Shirou. Cleaning changes from reciprocating hospitality to another part of caring for him.

contexts.japanese: ここで朝を過ごして、夕方もご飯を食べさせてもらってる
contexts.english: I spent the morning here, and I'm going to feed you dinner, too.

findings.description: Finding unused rooms already tended becomes us tending them without thinking.
findings.sourceReading: 気がつけば手入れされていて gives Shirou’s discovery of the upkeep that the next paragraph attributes especially to Sakura.
findings.explanation: Finding unused rooms already tended becomes us tending them without thinking.

contexts.japanese: 使わない部屋も気がつけば手入れされていて
contexts.english: we've been tending to the unused rooms without even really thinking about it

findings.description: Trying to hold him with one hand while holding the thermometer in the other becomes a threatening thermometer approaching.
findings.sourceReading: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる specifies the attempted bodily restraint.
findings.explanation: Trying to hold him with one hand while holding the thermometer in the other becomes a threatening thermometer approaching.

contexts.japanese: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる
contexts.english: The thermometer inches threateningly towards me, its holder losing her composure.

findings.description: Shirou glaring at Illya while holding the bag becomes Illya looking at his shopping bag.
findings.sourceReading: スーパーのビニール袋を手に、キッとイリヤを睨みつける has Shirou holding groceries and glaring at her before her curious stare back.
findings.explanation: Shirou glaring at Illya while holding the bag becomes Illya looking at his shopping bag.

contexts.japanese: スーパーのビニール袋を手に、キッとイリヤを睨みつける
contexts.english: Illya shoots a glance at the shopping bag in my hand.

findings.description: Fear he will dislike her if forced becomes her disliking coercion as a principle.
findings.sourceReading: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃう gives her fear of being disliked as the reason to leave despite not wanting to.
findings.explanation: Fear he will dislike her if forced becomes her disliking coercion as a principle.

contexts.japanese: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃう
contexts.english: I don't like forcing people to do things.

findings.description: Having been caught by her becomes having her here.
findings.sourceReading: こうして捕まってしまった以上 makes Shirou the caught party conceding to the chat she wants.
findings.explanation: Having been caught by her becomes having her here.

contexts.japanese: こうして捕まってしまった以上
contexts.english: As long as I've got her here

findings.description: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.
findings.sourceReading: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装う keeps a collective indifferent appearance until detecting enemy presence.
findings.explanation: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.

contexts.japanese: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装おう
contexts.english: I'll act helpless until we lure out an enemy.

findings.description: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou notices that Sakura has lowered her face for some unexplained reason, then asks whether she feels unwell.
findings.explanation: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.

contexts.japanese: なぜか、桜は俯いていた
contexts.english: Sakura is in my way.

findings.description: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.
findings.sourceReading: 迷惑をかけてばかりですけど……反省したんですよ continues her first-person acknowledgment of troubling him and reflecting she truly did something bad earlier.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.

contexts.japanese: さっきのは、ほんとに悪いコトをしたんだなあって反省したんですよ
contexts.english: I hope you realize that you were out of line earlier.

findings.description: Shirou freezing because he did not understand the reason becomes him wondering why Rider froze.
findings.sourceReading: 理由が分からなくて固まってた is his answer that he was stalled by not understanding her concern.
findings.explanation: Shirou freezing because he did not understand the reason becomes him wondering why Rider froze.

contexts.japanese: 理由が分からなくて固まってた
contexts.english: I just wasn't sure why you froze up.

findings.description: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.
findings.sourceReading: The quoted 嬉しいかって is the question he asked about her feeling at Rin’s stay, identified by31 and repeated to her in32.
findings.explanation: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんがここで寝泊りするようになって嬉しいかって
contexts.english: I said that you looked happy when she decided to sleep over.

contexts.japanese: 桜にとって今の状況がどんなものなのか、それを聞いていたんだっけ
contexts.english: I was listening to Sakura talk about our current living situation.

findings.description: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.
findings.sourceReading: Both 姉さんにも自分にも are perceived sources of accusation; 気がして preserves Sakura’s feeling rather than authenticating Rin’s blame.
findings.explanation: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにも自分にも、何をしてるんだって責められてる気がして
contexts.english: no matter what she or I do, it ends up with her scolding me.

findings.description: The sisters’ mutual watching becomes Sakura alone watching Rin.
findings.sourceReading: わたしたちはお互い establishes reciprocal attention at a distance.
findings.explanation: The sisters’ mutual watching becomes Sakura alone watching Rin.

contexts.japanese: わたしたちはお互いを遠くからよく見てた
contexts.english: I fixated on it, and often watched her from afar.

findings.description: The English assigns Sakura’s blush to Tohsaka, who is next door, and changes Sakura’s murmuring into uneasy glances.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura blushes and murmurs her reply to Shirou; Rin is in the adjacent room.
findings.explanation: The English assigns Sakura’s blush to Tohsaka, who is next door, and changes Sakura’s murmuring into uneasy glances.

contexts.japanese: 桜は頬を赤らめてごにょごにょと口にする
contexts.english: Tohsaka blushes and looks around uneasily too

findings.description: Shirou’s stunned observation becomes Illya staring at him.
findings.sourceReading: The first-person narrator watches Illya before describing her; she has also separately observed him, mentioned in12.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s stunned observation becomes Illya staring at him.

contexts.japanese: 呆然と、目の前にいるイリヤを観察する
contexts.english: Illya is staring at me.

findings.description: Illya’s own difficulty becomes difficulty for Shirou dealing with her.
findings.sourceReading: イリヤはイリヤで、やっぱり大変なんだ recognizes her separate predicament; he finds responding to that difficult.
findings.explanation: Illya’s own difficulty becomes difficulty for Shirou dealing with her.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはイリヤで、やっぱり大変なんだ
contexts.english: Illya is who she is, and this isn't easy for me.

findings.description: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.
findings.sourceReading: She had proposed installing a circuit switch and now cancels that plan because making easy on/off possible would endanger him.
findings.explanation: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.

contexts.japanese: この前は士郎の体にスイッチをいれようって言ってたけど、アレは止めるわ
contexts.english: You've talked about flipping a switch in your body before, but don't do that this time.

contexts.japanese: ここで簡単に魔術回路の開閉ができるようになったら
contexts.english: You'll be in danger if you open and close your Magic Circuits carelessly.

findings.description: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.
findings.sourceReading: Running away would make it look even more as though HE is conscious of Rin, leaving him no excuse.
findings.explanation: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.

contexts.japanese: そんなコトをしたらますます遠坂を意識しているようで
contexts.english: it'll just make Tohsaka more self-conscious

findings.description: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.
findings.sourceReading: As his girlfriend she says it is wrong for HIM to get flustered around her sister;39 explicitly asks him to restrain it.
findings.explanation: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにドキマギするのおかしいですっ
contexts.english: I'm just being weird for letting my sister get to my head!

findings.description: Her gaze painful to him becomes her looking hurt.
findings.sourceReading: 桜の視線が痛かった recalls the gaze that made him uncomfortable in6 and11; he now identifies her sulking as its reason.
findings.explanation: Her gaze painful to him becomes her looking hurt.

contexts.japanese: 桜の視線がさっきから痛かった
contexts.english: Sakura's been looking so hurt

findings.description: Illya's suggestion that Shirou should have cooked instead becomes a suggestion that he should help mediate while the sisters cook.
findings.sourceReading: Illya says Shirou could have cooked himself as the compromise instead of assigning Rin and Sakura together.
findings.explanation: Illya's suggestion that Shirou should have cooked instead becomes a suggestion that he should help mediate while the sisters cook.

contexts.japanese: 間をとるんだったらシロウが作ればよかった
contexts.english: shouldn't you be there to bridge the gap between them?

findings.description: Rin immediately correcting Sakura’s errors becomes Sakura worrying she has erred.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が何か失敗するとすぐ注意をする keeps Rin as the correcting actor; her constant attention under brusqueness is then inferred.
findings.explanation: Rin immediately correcting Sakura’s errors becomes Sakura worrying she has erred.

contexts.japanese: 桜が何か失敗するとすぐ注意をする
contexts.english: Sakura immediately worries she's done something wrong.

findings.description: What shaped Shinji becomes something he constructed in his head. The family revelation still overturns his self-image, but the sentence shifts emphasis toward his own mental construction.
findings.sourceReading: The revelation overturns both what Shinji believed and what had shaped him.
findings.explanation: What shaped Shinji becomes something he constructed in his head. The family revelation still overturns his self-image, but the sentence shifts emphasis toward his own mental construction.

contexts.japanese: 彼を形成していたもの
contexts.english: that he'd constructed in his head

findings.description: Being able to discard brotherly dignity becomes losing dignity.
findings.sourceReading: 兄の尊厳も捨てられた says ignoring him would allow him to abandon the brother-role dignity and its hope.
findings.explanation: Being able to discard brotherly dignity becomes losing dignity.

contexts.japanese: 兄の尊厳も捨てられた
contexts.english: he would have lost his dignity

findings.description: Sakura finishing the food and rice becomes the whole group finishing it.
findings.sourceReading: 桜 remains subject of eating and 片付けてくれた while Rin watches surprised.
findings.explanation: Sakura finishing the food and rice becomes the whole group finishing it.

contexts.japanese: 桜は美味しそうに箸を進め、綺麗さっぱりおかずと米を片付けてくれた
contexts.english: until we completely finished all of the food and rice.

findings.description: Neither having room for serious discussion becomes Shirou not being in the mood.
findings.sourceReading: お互い……余裕なんてない concerns their mutual lack of room to discuss amid danger.
findings.explanation: Neither having room for serious discussion becomes Shirou not being in the mood.

contexts.japanese: お互い真剣に話し合う余裕なんてない
contexts.english: I'm not in the mood even for a serious talk

findings.description: Rin’s near-daily archery-club watching becomes Sakura hanging around the club.
findings.sourceReading: わたし governs her watching whenever free; since Sakura entered her school, Rin visited the club almost daily to observe her.
findings.explanation: Rin’s near-daily archery-club watching becomes Sakura hanging around the club.

contexts.japanese: あの子がわたしと同じ学園に入ってからは毎日のように弓道部に入り浸ってた
contexts.english: She's been hanging around the kyudo club ever since we ended up in the same school.

findings.description: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.
findings.sourceReading: 人の手が入りまくった頭 describes his mind having other people’s intervention throughout, echoing invasive/cooking reconstruction imagery.
findings.explanation: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.

contexts.japanese: お節介なまでに人の手が入りまくった頭
contexts.english: My useless head, that only knows how to help other people so much it's a nuisance

findings.description: Smearing liquid all over itself becomes flowing liquid covering it.
findings.sourceReading: 塗りたくる names the creature’s deliberate spreading of liquid as supposed protection.
findings.explanation: Smearing liquid all over itself becomes flowing liquid covering it.

contexts.japanese: 流れ出る液体を全身に塗りたくる
contexts.english: Flowing liquid covers its body.

findings.description: Realizing she herself can do it becomes thinking an it might do it for her.
findings.sourceReading: 自分にはソレが出来る assigns the capacity to her, with ソレ the elimination she imagined.
findings.explanation: Realizing she herself can do it becomes thinking an it might do it for her.

contexts.japanese: 自分にはソレが出来るコトに気がついた
contexts.english: she naturally thought that it might be able to do it for her.

findings.description: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願う modifies the person whose happiness SHE wishes, whom she fears ruining for her own happiness.
findings.explanation: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願うただ一人の人間
contexts.english: the one and only person who wants her to become happy.

findings.description: Candy-like contorting hallway becomes Shirou moving like molasses.
findings.sourceReading: 飴のようにぐにゃぐにゃに曲がりくねった modifies the perceived hallway.
findings.explanation: Candy-like contorting hallway becomes Shirou moving like molasses.

contexts.japanese: 飴のようにぐにゃぐにゃに曲がりくねった廊下
contexts.english: feeling like molasses oozing through the meandering hallways.

findings.description: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.
findings.sourceReading: それを知られるのは……良くはない specifically concerns the girls learning of it, explaining why he must return unnoticed.
findings.explanation: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.

contexts.japanese: それを知られるのは遠坂にも
contexts.english: It isn't fair to Tohsaka or the sleeping Sakura.

findings.description: What sustained Shirou becomes something he rejects, instead of something that now rejects him. The change alters the direction of his internal accusation.
findings.sourceReading: What has sustained him would turn against and negate him if he allowed the tragedy to recur.
findings.explanation: What sustained Shirou becomes something he rejects, instead of something that now rejects him. The change alters the direction of his internal accusation.

contexts.japanese: 今までおまえを支えてきたモノが、おまえ自身を否定する
contexts.english: you'd be rejecting everyone and everything that's supported you this far.

findings.description: People who failed to prevent the deaths become innocent victims unable to resist.
findings.sourceReading: それを防げなかった人間 includes the preventers whose failure also wounds them, contrasted with actual victims in the prior clause.
findings.explanation: People who failed to prevent the deaths become innocent victims unable to resist.

contexts.japanese: それを防げなかった人間も
contexts.english: Innocent people, unable to resist.

findings.description: An answer already fatally fixed becomes a conscious choice made with fatal conviction.
findings.sourceReading: 答えは決まっていた locates the settled answer from the earlier embrace; his inability to act has only now made him realize it.
findings.explanation: An answer already fatally fixed becomes a conscious choice made with fatal conviction.

contexts.japanese: 致命的なまでに、この答えは決まっていた
contexts.english: It was a choice I made with fatal conviction

findings.description: Leaving people to die becomes killing them directly.
findings.sourceReading: 見殺し identifies failure to save in his self-accusation.
findings.explanation: Leaving people to die becomes killing them directly.

contexts.japanese: 多くの人間を見殺しにした正義の味方
contexts.english: A "hero" who will kill many people tonight

findings.description: Things he believed and upheld become everyone who helped him.
findings.sourceReading: 信じ、支えてきたモノ concerns what he has believed and supported, in the abandonment of his own prior self.
findings.explanation: Things he believed and upheld become everyone who helped him.

contexts.japanese: 今まで信じ、支えてきたモノをなくして
contexts.english: leaving everything I've believed in, everyone who's helped me.

findings.description: Others refusing help becomes Sakura refusing to save others.
findings.sourceReading: After nobody helped her, the people who fail to help others naturally cannot expect help themselves: her rationalization of their deaths.
findings.explanation: Others refusing help becomes Sakura refusing to save others.

contexts.japanese: 他人を助けてあげないんだから、他人に助けてもらえないのは当たり前
contexts.english: That I won't save them, so it makes sense that they won't save me, either.

findings.description: Repeating his promise as the only way to forgive becomes repeated forgiveness itself.
findings.sourceReading: そう繰り返す refers to the just-spoken promise to protect; this repetition is their present means of forgiving each other.
findings.explanation: Repeating his promise as the only way to forgive becomes repeated forgiveness itself.

contexts.japanese: 今はそう繰り返すしか、互いを許す術がなかった
contexts.english: All we can do is forgive each other, over and over.

findings.description: He tries to meet Sakura’s gaze becomes her effort to make eye contact.
findings.sourceReading: The continuing first-person subject takes a chair and aligns his gaze with the lying Sakura as much as possible.
findings.explanation: He tries to meet Sakura’s gaze becomes her effort to make eye contact.

contexts.japanese: 横になった桜と視線をできるだけ合わせる
contexts.english: Sakura does her best to make eye contact from where she's lying.

findings.description: Her magical-energy adequacy must be true becomes putting up with his embarrassment.
findings.sourceReading: そうであってもらわないと困る says it is necessary that the sufficient-energy answer actually hold.
findings.explanation: Her magical-energy adequacy must be true becomes putting up with his embarrassment.

contexts.japanese: そうであってもらわないと困る
contexts.english: so I'll have to put up with it.

findings.description: Immersing himself by the incantation becomes the incantation embedding itself in him.
findings.sourceReading: 呪文で自己に埋没すれば is his conditional inward focusing through reciting the spell, improving Projection.
findings.explanation: Immersing himself by the incantation becomes the incantation embedding itself in him.

contexts.japanese: 呪文で自己に埋没すれば
contexts.english: once it embedded itself in me

findings.description: Rin’s self-mockery for watching disappears.
findings.sourceReading: やっぱりバカみたいに眺めてた repeats idiot-like for her own watching, alongside his repeated impossible attempts.
findings.explanation: Rin’s self-mockery for watching disappears.

contexts.japanese: やっぱりバカみたいに眺めてた
contexts.english: I saw some boy at the edge of campus trying over and over to jump a bar that was too high for him, like a moron.

findings.description: Sakura repeatedly voicing her true feelings becomes simply starting to say the examples.
findings.sourceReading: 本音を立て続けに assigns unguarded true feelings to her successive greetings/wishes as Rin reads them.
findings.explanation: Sakura repeatedly voicing her true feelings becomes simply starting to say the examples.

contexts.japanese: 本音を立て続けに言われた時
contexts.english: when she started saying things like

findings.description: Her treasured rarity being diminished becomes Rin actively treating it as ordinary.
findings.sourceReading: The memory loses rarity as she learns Rin also saw it, in Sakura’s wounded perception.
findings.explanation: Her treasured rarity being diminished becomes Rin actively treating it as ordinary.

contexts.japanese: ただの記憶に貶められていく
contexts.english: who was now treating it like any other memory.

findings.description: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯自体の魂 is the vessel’s own personality/soul, excluded by containing seven; next20 explains personality erasure.
findings.explanation: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯”自体の魂の入る余地なんてない
contexts.english: The container can't hold all of them.

findings.description: Sakura beyond saving gains Illya beyond saving as well.
findings.sourceReading: わたし marks the speaker of said; its content is Sakura cannot be saved.
findings.explanation: Sakura beyond saving gains Illya beyond saving as well.

contexts.japanese: わたし、サクラはもう助からないって言ったのよ
contexts.english: I said that I'm beyond saving, just like Sakura, you know.

findings.description: Cannot promise and wanted nothing become no prior promises and Illya asking nothing.
findings.sourceReading: Both clauses continue Shirou: no promise he can make, no desired thing prompting the hug.
findings.explanation: Cannot promise and wanted nothing become no prior promises and Illya asking nothing.

contexts.japanese: 何も約束なんて出来ないし、何がほしかったワケでもない
contexts.english: I never made her any promises, nor did she ask for anything.

findings.description: Ordinarily achievable April wish becomes a categorical pledge to grant it repeatedly.
findings.sourceReading: 幾らでも叶えられる modifies the wish’s ordinary attainability in April; it is also his own wish.
findings.explanation: Ordinarily achievable April wish becomes a categorical pledge to grant it repeatedly.

contexts.japanese: 四月にさえなれば幾らでも叶えられる願い
contexts.english: Once April comes, I'll grant it as many times as it takes.

findings.description: Something he promised to protect becomes someone who protects her.
findings.sourceReading: 守ると言ってくれたモノ refers to what he has promised to protect, followed by its remaining shape even if dirty/cowardly.
findings.explanation: Something he promised to protect becomes someone who protects her.

contexts.japanese: 守ると言ってくれたモノがある
contexts.english: Even she has someone willing to protect her.

findings.description: Why they ended this way becomes why she did it to him.
findings.sourceReading: 自分たちはこんな事になってしまった asks how their shared condition came about.
findings.explanation: Why they ended this way becomes why she did it to him.

contexts.japanese: 自分たちはこんな事になってしまったのだろう
contexts.english: Why did she do this to him?

findings.description: The condition for treating Shirou as an enemy changes from Sakura seeing him as one to Rider judging him dangerous. This alters the specific danger Sakura fears from Rider's continuing protection.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Shirou supports Sakura, Sakura's own recognition of him as an enemy would make him an external enemy to be defeated.
findings.explanation: The condition for treating Shirou as an enemy changes from Sakura seeing him as one to Rider judging him dangerous. This alters the specific danger Sakura fears from Rider's continuing protection.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜が衛宮士郎を敵と認識してしまえば
contexts.english: if she judges him a threat to Sakura.

findings.description: Holding her coughing chest becomes holding back a cough.
findings.sourceReading: 咳きこむ胸を押さえながら states hand pressure on chest while coughing.
findings.explanation: Holding her coughing chest becomes holding back a cough.

contexts.japanese: 咳きこむ胸を押さえながら
contexts.english: holding back a cough.

findings.description: His mistaken reading of her question becomes her belief about his ability.
findings.sourceReading: てっきり...話だと思った is what Shirou had assumed the discussion concerned.
findings.explanation: His mistaken reading of her question becomes her belief about his ability.

contexts.japanese: てっきりアーチャーの腕を使えるかって話だと思った
contexts.english: Does she think I can use Archer's arm already...?

findings.description: Shirou’s agreement conditions her help becomes Illya’s prior promise.
findings.sourceReading: シロウが約束したのなら is if Shirou agreed/promised, despite her opposition.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s agreement conditions her help becomes Illya’s prior promise.

contexts.japanese: シロウが約束したのなら手伝ってあげる
contexts.english: But I did promise to help you.

findings.description: A smile that tickles him becomes her shy smile delivering the blow.
findings.sourceReading: こっちがくすぐったくなるような gives its effect on him; 殺人的な返答 is her answer’s comic blow.
findings.explanation: A smile that tickles him becomes her shy smile delivering the blow.

contexts.japanese: こっちがくすぐったくなるような笑顔で、桜は殺人的な返答をする
contexts.english: Her shy smile is like a mortal blow to the heart.

findings.description: They think we lack countermeasures becomes they cannot attack us directly.
findings.sourceReading: わたしたちに手がないと思って attributes to enemy belief that Rin/Shirou lack means to respond.
findings.explanation: They think we lack countermeasures becomes they cannot attack us directly.

contexts.japanese: わたしたちに手がないと思って
contexts.english: because they can't come directly after us.

findings.description: Leaving two in the dojo becomes two sisters leaving it.
findings.sourceReading: Rin leaves Shirou and Illya inside; Sakura is already outside and is refused entry3.
findings.explanation: Leaving two in the dojo becomes two sisters leaving it.

contexts.japanese: 二人を道場に残して中庭に出る。
contexts.english: The two sisters leave the dojo and enter the yard.

findings.description: Making Shirou do more becomes doing more to him.
findings.sourceReading: なにをさせよう asks what further action Rin will make him perform.
findings.explanation: Making Shirou do more becomes doing more to him.

contexts.japanese: これ以上なにをさせようって言うんです
contexts.english: to do even more things to him

findings.description: Shirou has no right to speak becomes Rin has no right to order him.
findings.sourceReading: 士郎に発言権はない denies his say, preceding her ownership assertion.
findings.explanation: Shirou has no right to speak becomes Rin has no right to order him.

contexts.japanese: そもそも本当なら士郎に発言権はないの。
contexts.english: nor do I have the right to order him around.

findings.description: Supporting his wish and borrowing reciprocally becomes wanting him to fight and borrowing.
findings.sourceReading: He desires battle, so she lends all her help and receives his; both directions are explicit.
findings.explanation: Supporting his wish and borrowing reciprocally becomes wanting him to fight and borrowing.

contexts.japanese: わたしはあいつが戦いを望む以上、全力で力を貸すし、貸してもらうだけなんだから
contexts.english: I want him to fight, so I'll borrow his power as much as I need to.

findings.description: Sakura’s characteristic stew becomes her preference for white stews.
findings.sourceReading: 桜のシチューっていったらホワイト identifies the stew she makes as white, motivating chicken purchase.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s characteristic stew becomes her preference for white stews.

contexts.japanese: 桜のシチューっていったらホワイト
contexts.english: Sakura likes white stews

findings.description: Surviving by sacrificing the other becomes the other surviving when one makes a sacrifice.
findings.sourceReading: どっちかがどっちかを犠牲にすれば makes one sacrifice the other and possibly live; direction follows ordinary omitted subject of 生きられる.
findings.explanation: Surviving by sacrificing the other becomes the other surviving when one makes a sacrifice.

contexts.japanese: どっちかがどっちかを犠牲にすれば、少しは生きられるかもしれない
contexts.english: if one of us makes a sacrifice, the other might be able to live a little longer.

findings.description: An existing lookalike object reinforced through Projection becomes a Projection supplemented by more magecraft. This changes the method being contrasted with Shirou's complete mental construction.
findings.sourceReading: Ordinary Projection can be layered onto an object resembling the original to reinforce it. Shirou instead must construct everything through his own mental image.
findings.explanation: An existing lookalike object reinforced through Projection becomes a Projection supplemented by more magecraft. This changes the method being contrasted with Shirou's complete mental construction.

contexts.japanese: オリジナルに似せた物に“投影”を重ねて“補強”する事はできる。
contexts.english: Projection magecraft, can supplement a Projection that resembles the original to a degree.

findings.description: Temporary memory impairment becomes the loss of a fleeting memory fragment. This belongs with Shirou's threatened loss of self.
findings.sourceReading: Using the arm will cause more than the temporary memory impairment Shirou experienced earlier.
findings.explanation: Temporary memory impairment becomes the loss of a fleeting memory fragment. This belongs with Shirou's threatened loss of self.

contexts.japanese: さっきみたいな一時的な記憶の欠損なんかじゃすまされない。
contexts.english: It'll take more than a fleeting fragment of his memories.

findings.description: Either cook becomes both cooks.
findings.sourceReading: 俺か遠坂 offers either Shirou or Rin as substitute.
findings.explanation: Either cook becomes both cooks.

contexts.japanese: 夕飯は俺か遠坂が作る
contexts.english: Tohsaka and I would make dinner

findings.description: Sakura’s surprise at Rin’s surprise disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Rin’s reaction surprises both Shirou and Sakura.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s surprise at Rin’s surprise disappears.

contexts.japanese: 俺と桜が驚くぐらい
contexts.english: more surprise than I expected.

findings.description: Rin’s criticism supposedly causes Sakura’s delighted answer.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou ignores Rin’s criticism in the face of Sakura’s joy at permission.
findings.explanation: Rin’s criticism supposedly causes Sakura’s delighted answer.

contexts.japanese: だが、そんなものは、
contexts.english: but that only made Sakura say,

contexts.japanese: 桜の喜びの前では、これっぽっちも気にならなかった。
contexts.english: It was hard to be negative in front of that much enthusiasm.

findings.description: Chopsticks dropping becomes food dropping.
findings.sourceReading: その度に箸は落ちて explicitly drops the implements and hurriedly picks them up.
findings.explanation: Chopsticks dropping becomes food dropping.

contexts.japanese: その度に箸は落ちて
contexts.english: only to drop it each time

findings.description: Sakura does not register observers becomes observers not seeing her.
findings.sourceReading: 桜には俺たちが見えていない makes Sakura the impaired perceiver, absorbed in her repeated effort.
findings.explanation: Sakura does not register observers becomes observers not seeing her.

contexts.japanese: 桜には俺たちが見えていない。
contexts.english: we don't see it.

contexts.japanese: ……見えていない。
contexts.english: We're not looking.

findings.description: Her repeated normality claim becomes his internal reassurance about dinner.
findings.sourceReading: 自分はいつも通りだ、と訴えるように follows Sakura as subject repeating gestures as if insisting she is normal.
findings.explanation: Her repeated normality claim becomes his internal reassurance about dinner.

contexts.japanese: 自分はいつも通りだ、と訴えるように
contexts.english: I tell myself it's just dinner as usual

findings.description: Recognizing his face becomes reading his face earlier.
findings.sourceReading: 先輩の顔だって判ります means she recognizes Shirou’s face, claimed alongside remembering yesterday.
findings.explanation: Recognizing his face becomes reading his face earlier.

contexts.japanese: 先輩の顔だって判ります
contexts.english: I could tell from your face earlier, too!

findings.description: Current effect compared to amplified school barrier becomes school barrier already instantaneous and powerful.
findings.sourceReading: Current dissolution resembles a version of Rider’s school field made instantaneous and stronger.
findings.explanation: Current effect compared to amplified school barrier becomes school barrier already instantaneous and powerful.

contexts.japanese: あの結界を、瞬間的かつ強力にした魔術みたいなもの
contexts.english: the Bounded Field Rider deployed at the school was like magecraft with an instantaneous and powerful effect.

findings.description: Victim cannot fully hate despite injury becomes world never stops hating victim despite its actions.
findings.sourceReading: 肉は何をされようと人の世を憎みきれぬ makes meat the one unable to finish hating, whatever is done to it.
findings.explanation: Victim cannot fully hate despite injury becomes world never stops hating victim despite its actions.

contexts.japanese: 肉は何をされようと人の世を憎みきれぬ。
contexts.english: The world will never exhaust its hate for the meat, no matter what it does.

findings.description: Doing anything to victim has no effect becomes victim’s actions do not matter.
findings.sourceReading: 肉には何をしても効果はない concludes abuse fails to break restraint.
findings.explanation: Doing anything to victim has no effect becomes victim’s actions do not matter.

contexts.japanese: 肉には何をしても効果はないのだ。
contexts.english: nothing the meat does will matter.

findings.description: Boy sustained victim’s unexpected growth becomes boy unexpectedly grew and survived.
findings.sourceReading: 予想外の成長 resumes the sacrificial subject6–8; boy 保たせてくれた kept it going so he should supply ending.
findings.explanation: Boy sustained victim’s unexpected growth becomes boy unexpectedly grew and survived.

contexts.japanese: 予想外の成長ではあったが、あそこまで保たせてくれたのだ。
contexts.english: He has grown more than expected, but managed to survive this long.

findings.description: Who is running becomes whom she runs from.
findings.sourceReading: 誰が asks subject of flight as observer/entity distinction fractures.
findings.explanation: Who is running becomes whom she runs from.

contexts.japanese: 誰が？
contexts.english: From whom?

findings.description: Cloth-like hand reaching becomes reaching for cloth.
findings.sourceReading: 布キレみたいな modifies her damaged hand as she clings to new happiness.
findings.explanation: Cloth-like hand reaching becomes reaching for cloth.

contexts.japanese: 布キレみたいな手を伸ばして
contexts.english: reaching for that shred of cloth,

findings.description: Everyone sacrificed becomes everyone voluntarily gave up life.
findings.sourceReading: みんなを犠牲にして describes others sacrificed to free a single saving place, survivor-guilt reckoning.
findings.explanation: Everyone sacrificed becomes everyone voluntarily gave up life.

contexts.japanese: みんなを犠牲にして、一人分だけ、救える席が出来ただけだ。
contexts.english: They all gave up their lives so that one person might live.

findings.description: Walking new path together becomes being shown new path.
findings.sourceReading: 共に歩かせた keeps shared life with Kiritsugu, lost when guide dies7.
findings.explanation: Walking new path together becomes being shown new path.

contexts.japanese: 新しい道を共に歩かせた。
contexts.english: showed you a new path.

findings.description: Kiritsugu placing a dream in the boy becomes showing the boy a dream.
findings.sourceReading: 君に夢を見て means seeing hope/dream in Shirou, died entrusting future fulfillment to him.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu placing a dream in the boy becomes showing the boy a dream.

contexts.japanese: 君に夢を見て亡くなった。
contexts.english: He showed you a dream as he walked ahead of you, and then he died.

findings.description: Losing arm after saving life becomes losing precarious life without dying.
findings.sourceReading: たかが片腕…今では無くしたとしても死ぬ事はない says now life saved, loss of just one arm need not kill him.
findings.explanation: Losing arm after saving life becomes losing precarious life without dying.

contexts.japanese: たかが片腕、命を取り留めた今では無くしたとしても死ぬ事はない。
contexts.english: Even if you were to lose your life that hangs by a thread, you will not simply die.

findings.description: Shirou's expectation that all the pieces will be at his destination becomes a statement that Zouken has his pawns in hand. This shifts the tactical emphasis from gathering to possession without proving total control over anyone.
findings.sourceReading: Given Zouken's presumed interest in Illya, Shirou should expect all the pieces to be assembled at his destination.
findings.explanation: Shirou's expectation that all the pieces will be at his destination becomes a statement that Zouken has his pawns in hand. This shifts the tactical emphasis from gathering to possession without proving total control over anyone.

contexts.japanese: 向かう先には全ての駒が揃っていると見るべきだ。
contexts.english: then he has all of his pawns in hand.

findings.description: Come if you want formal attire becomes they need to fetch her dress.
findings.sourceReading: 正装がほしかったら城に来い reports Illya’s conditional invitation/order concerning needed attire.
findings.explanation: Come if you want formal attire becomes they need to fetch her dress.

contexts.japanese: 正装がほしかったら城に来いって言っていた。
contexts.english: She said that they needed to go to her castle to get her dress.

findings.description: The Japanese attributes the remembered name to another girl. The English instead calls Sella the “other caretaker” and makes Illya the apparent speaker.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou remembers Illya’s caretaker as the woman another girl called Sella.
findings.explanation: The Japanese attributes the remembered name to another girl. The English instead calls Sella the “other caretaker” and makes Illya the apparent speaker.

contexts.japanese: もう一人の子にセラと呼ばれていた
contexts.english: whom she called Sella.

findings.description: Weight on finger holds and body fixed with tiny footholds becomes scouting holds.
findings.sourceReading: それだけの手掛かりに体重を預け…足場で体を固定 describes actual bearing weight and anchoring with undersized footholds.
findings.explanation: Weight on finger holds and body fixed with tiny footholds becomes scouting holds.

contexts.japanese: 体重を預けて、これまた爪先ほどもない足場で体を固定する。
contexts.english: I cautiously scout out the thinnest of lips or crevices I can use to support my entire body weight.

findings.description: Pulling free becomes wildly waving arms.
findings.sourceReading: 手を振り払って releases Kirei’s hold then slaps his cheek.
findings.explanation: Pulling free becomes wildly waving arms.

contexts.japanese: すぐさま手を振り払って
contexts.english: Illya wildly waves her arms

findings.description: Arm shaking becomes legs throbbing.
findings.sourceReading: 腕が震動する then wrapped left arm pulses/swells sensation.
findings.explanation: Arm shaking becomes legs throbbing.

contexts.japanese: 腕が震動する。
contexts.english: My legs throb.

findings.description: Right arm becomes left arm.
findings.sourceReading: 右腕 locates inherited Command Spells.
findings.explanation: Right arm becomes left arm.

contexts.japanese: 右腕には
contexts.english: his left arm contains

findings.description: Incipient tear and muscles crying become tear and boy crying.
findings.sourceReading: 断裂しかけて muscles about to tear; their personified cry warns of bone snapping.
findings.explanation: Incipient tear and muscles crying become tear and boy crying.

contexts.japanese: 足の筋肉が断裂しかけて
contexts.english: My leg muscles tear, and I cry out in pain

findings.description: Identity revelation becomes Illya fixation.
findings.sourceReading: それが黒い敵の正体だった reveals enemy identity after her naming Berserker.
findings.explanation: Identity revelation becomes Illya fixation.

contexts.japanese: それが、黒い敵の正体だった。
contexts.english: She's fixated on the dark enemy's identity.

findings.description: Arm landing direct hit becomes arm taking damage.
findings.sourceReading: 直撃するのはアサシンの魔腕のみ is only cursed arm landing direct hit.
findings.explanation: Arm landing direct hit becomes arm taking damage.

contexts.japanese: 直撃するのはアサシンの魔腕のみ。
contexts.english: Only Assassin's arm took any damage.

findings.description: Two astonished parties become Assassin two reasons.
findings.sourceReading: 一つは…アサシン then another leads76 Zouken speaking astonishment at survival.
findings.explanation: Two astonished parties become Assassin two reasons.

contexts.japanese: 一つは黒鍵によって動きを封じられたアサシン、
contexts.english: He's astonished for two reasons.

findings.description: Incarnate speaker swears becomes oath to incarnate self.
findings.sourceReading: 受肉した私が誓う incarnate I subject of swearing.
findings.explanation: Incarnate speaker swears becomes oath to incarnate self.
