findings.description: Unwanted by anyone becomes wanting nothing from anyone.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei denies a being unwanted by anyone, alongside denying congenital evil.
findings.explanation: Unwanted by anyone becomes wanting nothing from anyone.

contexts.japanese: 何者にも望まれぬモノ、生まれながらに悪であるモノなどない。
contexts.english: There is no one who wishes for nothing from anyone, and no one who is born evil.

findings.description: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.
findings.sourceReading: What he gained was only a way of living that brings death; next he cannot abandon that one possession.
findings.explanation: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.

contexts.japanese: そうして得たものは死を運ぶという生き方のみ。
contexts.english: His life brought only death to anything he obtained.

contexts.japanese: なら—その、たった一つだけ在った生き方を、どうしてここで放棄る事が出来るだろう。
contexts.english: If it's the only way he ever lived, how could he ever abandon it now?

findings.description: Kirei's charge assigned to Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: The enemy charges straight in; Shirou lacks that leg power and lowers himself for a counter against the approaching opponent.
findings.explanation: Kirei's charge assigned to Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 地を蹴り、一直線に“敵”は敵を討ちに迫る。
contexts.english: I run and make a beeline at my opponent.

contexts.japanese: こっちにはそれだけの足がない。
contexts.english: My legs don't have much power left.

contexts.japanese: 腰を落とし、正面から襲いくる敵の胸元を見据え、
contexts.english: I drop my hips, eye the chest of my approaching opponent, and...

findings.description: Enemy who attacked at speed becomes enemy Shirou attacked.
findings.sourceReading: The enemy who assaulted him with that speed disappears from view, folds to his left, and strikes.
findings.explanation: Enemy who attacked at speed becomes enemy Shirou attacked.

contexts.japanese: あの速度。あの勢いで襲撃した敵は、一瞬で視界から消え去り、
contexts.english: The enemy I attacked with such speed and power disappears from sight.

contexts.japanese: 長身を折り畳むよう俺の左横に屈み、拳で腹を殴りつけ、
contexts.english: He bends his tall body to my left flank, drives a fist into my stomach,

findings.description: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.
findings.sourceReading: Even pain from biting fingers of right hand cannot stop disappearing memory.
findings.explanation: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.

contexts.japanese: 右手の指を食べる痛みも、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

contexts.japanese: 自分が自分のままでいる事に、指を食うほど執着している。
contexts.english: I bite my fingers to remind myself that I'm still me.

findings.description: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.
findings.sourceReading: Tiny pendant has just one breath of mana; insufficient for much, but helps him extend his hand.
findings.explanation: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.

contexts.japanese: 何の役にも立たない、けれど、手を伸ばすぐらいは助けてくれる、小さな小さなペンダント。
contexts.english: It's completely useless, but the small, small pendant will make sure that someone saves me if I reach out with my hand.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
contexts.english: One breath of magical energy.

findings.description: Remaining Shirou and Rider become Shirou alone.
findings.sourceReading: After Rin goes on, boy and Rider remain.
findings.explanation: Remaining Shirou and Rider become Shirou alone.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂が奥に進み、残されたのは俺とライダーだけだ。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's gone, leaving only me.

contexts.japanese: 「殺す、とは聞き捨てなりませんね。貴方が手にかけるのはこの道を通る者のみ。彼がこの場に留まるのなら、貴方に襲われる事はない筈ですが」
contexts.english: "Did I hear you correctly? You said that you would only kill those who attempt to pass. If he stays here, you should not attack him."

contexts.japanese: 違いますか、ライダー」
contexts.english: Am I wrong, Rider?"

findings.description: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.
findings.sourceReading: Ruby reads crushing as playing: humans find daily life boring and meaningless without play and suffer thirst without drinking. Sakura uses normal human needs to normalize her crushing and swallowing.
findings.explanation: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.

contexts.japanese: 人間は潰していないと毎日がつまらなくて意味がないし、飲まないと渇いて苦しいでしょう？
contexts.english: Humans live such boring, pointless lives before I play with them. And I get thirsty, too.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。だって、人を潰すのも呑み込むのも変わらないもの。
contexts.english: "Yes. After all, crushing people isn't any different from swallowing them.

contexts.japanese: ほら、だから同じ。姉さんと変わらない。わたしは当たり前のように、みんながしているコトをするだけです」
contexts.english: See? I'm just like you, Nee-san. I'm just doing what everyone else does."

findings.description: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.
findings.sourceReading: Semantic ruby says 私の足は緑を覆う: feet are subject of covering green.
findings.explanation: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.

contexts.japanese: Es erzählt—Mein Schatten nimmt Sie！」
contexts.english: Es erzählt... (Let my voice carry far....) Mein Schatten nimmt sie...! (Let my feet be wreathed in green...!)"

findings.description: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura grinds her teeth thinking it is like Excalibur's very light.
findings.explanation: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの宝具、エクスカリバーの光そのものではないか、と少女は歯を軋ませる。
contexts.english: She stops herself from saying that it's almost exactly like Saber's Excalibur.

findings.description: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Sakura continues attacking until Rin's stamina ends, cave collapse afterward means Sakura loses.
findings.explanation: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.

contexts.japanese: 仮に、遠坂凛の体力が尽きるまで攻め続けたとしても、その後に待つものは洞窟の崩壊なのだ。
contexts.english: Even if Rin were to attack until her physical strength failed her, the cave would collapse after.

contexts.japanese: このまま徒に戦いを続けては間桐桜の敗北となる。
contexts.english: Continuing this vain battle would mean failure for Sakura.

findings.description: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.
findings.sourceReading: Despite knowing attacks are pointless and strangle her own prospects, Sakura keeps screaming.
findings.explanation: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.

contexts.japanese: 無意味と知りながら、自らの首を絞めると理解していながら、間桐桜は叫び続ける。
contexts.english: Sakura screams, knowing it's pointless, the comprehension wringing her neck.

findings.description: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.
findings.sourceReading: Rin silently cuts down the crying, imploring girl with shadow ruby; image overlays pleading Sakura and her approaching shadow.
findings.explanation: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.

contexts.japanese: 泣いて縋ってくる少女を、彼女は無言で斬り伏せる。
contexts.english: Rin cuts away the shadows clinging to the crying girl.

findings.description: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.
findings.sourceReading: Overwhelmed by sister, girl was on point of refusing the fight before despair renews curses.
findings.explanation: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.

contexts.japanese: 姉に圧され、戦いを拒否しかけていた少女は、絶望と共に呪いを具現化させていく。
contexts.english: Driven back by her sister and denied even a proper fight, the girl materializes more curses in her despair.

findings.description: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.
findings.sourceReading: Continuing address to Rin: you lack even fragment of what I wanted you to possess, yet insist you alone remain clean.
findings.explanation: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.

contexts.japanese: 持っていて欲しかったものを一欠片も持たないクセに、　自分だけはキレイなままだと言い張って—！
contexts.english: I've never had a single thing I wanted, but you just keep on insisting on how clean you are...!

contexts.japanese: わたしのコトなんて好きでも嫌いでもないクセに、
contexts.english: You don't care about me at all.

findings.description: Fetus's glaring motion becomes boy looking around.
findings.sourceReading: ぎょろり introduces eyeless distorted fetus looking at him in next clause.
findings.explanation: Fetus's glaring motion becomes boy looking around.

contexts.japanese: ぎょろり、と。
contexts.english: I look around.

contexts.japanese: 目玉もないクセに、歪な胎児が俺を見る。
contexts.english: The eyeless, twisted fetus is looking at me.

findings.description: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.
findings.sourceReading: こうしている自分 continues the object of Sakura's rejection: herself in this state, then her bloodied/blackened self and connected shadow.
findings.explanation: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.

contexts.japanese: こうしている自分。
contexts.english: She did this.

contexts.japanese: 桜は拒んでいる。
contexts.english: She's in denial.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の血に濡れた自分、黒く染まった自分、自分に繋がったあの黒い影を、半狂乱になりながら、全力で憎んでいる。
contexts.english: In a near-craze, she hates herself with all her heart—herself for soaking in Tohsaka's blood, herself for being corrupted, herself for connecting to the Shadow.

findings.description: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.
findings.sourceReading: わたしだって我慢しません threatens that she too will stop restraining herself if he comes closer.
findings.explanation: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.

contexts.japanese: 先輩、先輩がそれ以上近寄るなら、わたしだって我慢しません。先輩に殺される前に、わたしが先輩を殺しちゃうんだから……！」
contexts.english: I-if you come any closer, I won't be able to hold it back. I'll kill you before you can kill me...!"

contexts.japanese: 今のは桜が、自分の意志で俺を押しのけようとしたものだ。
contexts.english: Sakura did it out of her own will, to push me away.

findings.description: Arm's frantic autonomous repair becomes Shirou working the arm.
findings.sourceReading: Left arm itself becomes frantic trying to repair his pulverized frame, causing whitening and mental erosion.
findings.explanation: Arm's frantic autonomous repair becomes Shirou working the arm.

contexts.japanese: それを修復しようと左腕が躍起になり、結果—
contexts.english: I work my left arm to try and repair it, and—

contexts.japanese: それは敵によるダメージではなく、傷ついた体を直し、書き換えようとする、左腕からの痛みだった。
contexts.english: It isn't the damage from his attacks, but from the pain of my left arm repairing and overwriting my injured body.

findings.description: Missing an opportunity becomes letting Kirei go.
findings.sourceReading: ここを逃したら refers to losing this final chance, explicit この奇跡、この好機.
findings.explanation: Missing an opportunity becomes letting Kirei go.

contexts.japanese: これが最後、ここを逃したら本当に後がない、この奇跡、この好機に、残った命を全てつぎ込む—！
contexts.english: This is the end, if I let him go there's no future, I need to put everything I have left into this miracle, this chance...!

findings.description: Casual choice mistakes become rescue in a lighthearted tone.
findings.sourceReading: 軽い気持ちの modifies 選択ミス: decisions made casually lead to mistakes from which remix dojo saves player.
findings.explanation: Casual choice mistakes become rescue in a lighthearted tone.

contexts.japanese: 軽い気持ちの選択ミスから貴方を救う、タイガー道場リミックスだよー！
contexts.english: Welcome to Tiger Dojo Remixed, where we save you from your bad decisions in a lighthearted tone!

findings.description: Taiga's boast that Illya has finally noticed her tyranny becomes Taiga announcing her own realization. This changes the speaker relationship that completes the joke.
findings.sourceReading: After Illya calls her overbearing, Taiga triumphantly asks whether Illya has finally noticed, thirty-nine episodes in.
findings.explanation: Taiga's boast that Illya has finally noticed her tyranny becomes Taiga announcing her own realization. This changes the speaker relationship that completes the joke.

contexts.japanese: うむ、三十九回目にしてようやく気づいたかっ！
contexts.english: And I finally realized now that we're at the 39th episode!

contexts.japanese: そーなんだー。ネタバレとよく違いが分からないけど、とにかく師しょー横暴だー。
contexts.english: Uh-huh, okay. I don't know how that's different from a spoiler, but your house, your rules, Master.

findings.description: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Two successive days of hundred-person-scale harm would be intolerable for people/speaker.
findings.explanation: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そうね。百人単位の被害なんて、二日続けておきたらたまらないもの」
contexts.english: "Yeah. It probably can't keep causing hundreds of victims for more than a couple of days in a row."

findings.description: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.
findings.sourceReading: If his face is pale/ringed, even Sakura receiving care will feel obliged to worry about him.
findings.explanation: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.

contexts.japanese: ……まったく、嘘だと思うなら鏡を見てきなさい。顔面蒼白で目にクマ作ってたら、看病される桜だって気を遣うわ」
contexts.english: ...If you think I'm lying, go take a look in the mirror. You're deathly pale and got rings around your eyes like a raccoon. I'm doing you a favor by taking care of Sakura."

findings.description: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: Repeats 本体 from preceding alternative: main entity supplying mana/electricity to projector, distinct from Sakura projector.
findings.explanation: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.

contexts.english: "The person projecting it..."

contexts.japanese: もしアレを消せるとしたら、それは投影機である桜本人を消すか、投影機に魔力を送っている本体を消すしかないのではないか。
contexts.english: Even if I could erase it somehow, would that mean erasing the person projecting it—Sakura—or erasing whoever's providing power to the projector?

findings.description: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura went to settle 自分自身, herself as Holy Grail, despite fear of death, protecting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。けどシロウ。サクラが一人で外に出たのは、シロウに見られたくなかったからだよ。サクラはシロウを守る為に、怖いけど、死にたくないけど、聖杯である自分自身に決着をつけにいったの。
contexts.english: "Okay. But Shirou, Sakura left on her own because she didn't want you to see her. She did it to protect you. She's scared and she doesn't want to die, but she wants to settle things on her own, as a Holy Grail.

findings.description: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.
findings.sourceReading: Had planned to carry pitcher/nightclothes together with medicine; because of that they remain undelivered, and temperature not yet measured.
findings.explanation: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.

contexts.japanese: 薬と一緒に持っていこう、と思っていたので水差しと寝巻きもまだ渡していないし、今朝は熱も計っていない。
contexts.english: At first she was going to take the drug with her, but she still hasn't given Sakura the water pitcher and pajamas, nor taken her temperature.

findings.description: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura couldn't resolve it alone, so that guy tried to help; yet she went alone to resolve it after all. Conversation concerns Rider holding Rin until Sakura returns.
findings.explanation: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.

contexts.japanese: 「—ほんとに頭きた。一人じゃ出来ないからあいつが助けようとしたのに、結局、一人で解決しにいくなんてね」
contexts.english: "I'm so annoyed. I was trying to help him because he can't do this on his own, but he's going to end up trying anyway."

findings.description: Murmured judgment becomes unspoken appraisal.
findings.sourceReading: Illya murmurs 滑稽ね, comical, aloud.
findings.explanation: Murmured judgment becomes unspoken appraisal.

contexts.japanese: 滑稽ね、とイリヤは呟く。
contexts.english: She finds it rather comical.

findings.description: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Even otherwise Sakura already has one previous offense, so guarding Illya is natural for Rin.
findings.explanation: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.

contexts.japanese: 「まあね。わたしには士郎と違って、アンタを助ける理由がないもの。いよいよとなったらイリヤを攫いに来るのは明白でしょ。そうでなくても一度前科があるんだから、イリヤを見張るのは当然よ」
contexts.english: "Pretty much. Unlike Shirou, I don't have any reason to save you. It was obvious that you'd come to take Illya once things started rolling. Even if you didn't, you had plenty of reason to be cautious of her."

findings.description: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.
findings.sourceReading: Question causes chill because Sakura's voice is emotionless; clause leads into Rin's firm response.
findings.explanation: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.

contexts.japanese: それ故に寒気のする質問に、
contexts.english: Rin takes the question in stride.

contexts.japanese: 感情のない声。
contexts.english: Her voice contains no emotion.

findings.description: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.
findings.sourceReading: Following interrupted you-little insult, Rin glares while suppressing insult she would utter.
findings.explanation: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.

contexts.japanese: 侮辱をかみ殺しながら、凛は桜を睨み返す。
contexts.english: Rin glares at Sakura, enduring the humiliation.
"You...little..."

findings.description: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.
findings.sourceReading: She must stop the old man who made her Master even at cost of mutual destruction.
findings.explanation: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.

contexts.japanese: 自分をマスターにしたあの老人を、刺し違えてでも止めなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: She can't stop, even if she and the old man who turned her into a Master end up killing each other.

findings.description: He should know becomes I know.
findings.sourceReading: Despite grandfather surely knowing she is here, he doesn't appear; next of course he is aware confirms omitted subject.
findings.explanation: He should know becomes I know.

contexts.japanese: 「っ……知ってる、筈なの、に……！」
contexts.english: "I know...but...!"

contexts.japanese: そう、気付いていない筈がない。
contexts.english: Of course he's aware.

findings.description: Know conclusion becomes tell me conclusion.
findings.sourceReading: Internal demand 結論を知れ follows 結論を言え: know conclusion as well as get it stated, before boy confronts feared implications.
findings.explanation: Know conclusion becomes tell me conclusion.

contexts.japanese: 結論を知れ。
contexts.english: Tell me the conclusion.

contexts.japanese: 結論を言え。
contexts.english: Get to the point.

findings.description: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever reasons, offender must be punished; then equally valuable return will appease those deprived.
findings.explanation: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.

contexts.japanese: どんな理由があろうと、加害者は罰せられなくてはならない。
contexts.english: No matter what the circumstances were, the victims deserve to see some kind of punishment.

findings.description: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.
findings.sourceReading: He loved humans reaching higher/farther/broader, endlessly opening limits; made self evil for their sake.
findings.explanation: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.

contexts.japanese: より高く、より遠く、より広く。際限なく限界を切り開く人間を愛し、その為に、自身を絶対の悪とした。
contexts.english: His love for humanity was higher, further, and broader than any other. That is why he turned himself into absolute evil.

findings.description: Kiritsugu's suffering displeases Kotomine in the Japanese. The English instead says it makes Kiritsugu unhappy, removing one specific source of Kotomine's resentment.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine finds both Kiritsugu's existence and his anguish offensive, continuing his comparison between what Kiritsugu could abandon and what he himself never possessed.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's suffering displeases Kotomine in the Japanese. The English instead says it makes Kiritsugu unhappy, removing one specific source of Kotomine's resentment.

contexts.japanese: ヤツの存在はあまりにも不愉快だった。ヤツの苦悩は明らかに不快だった。
contexts.english: I found his existence extremely unpleasant. His suffering clearly made him unhappy.

findings.description: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.
findings.sourceReading: No concept of self, yet surprisingly such boy attached to a single life; then revises toward all lives.
findings.explanation: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.

contexts.japanese: おまえには自分という概念がない。だがそのおまえが、まさか一つの命に拘るとはな。いや、それとも—」
contexts.english: You have no concept of self. That is why you obsess over a single life. Or perhaps..."

findings.description: Unusually strong mind becomes unusually strong body.
findings.sourceReading: Personal opinion: Sakura spirit/mind unexpectedly strong and too compatible with curse.
findings.explanation: Unusually strong mind becomes unusually strong body.

contexts.japanese: 「これは私見だがな。間桐桜の精神は存外に強く、聖杯の“呪い”に適合しすぎている。
contexts.english: "This is only my personal opinion, but Sakura Matou's body is stronger and more suitable to the Holy Grail's curse than expected.

findings.description: Unanswering brother becomes wordless girl's look.
findings.sourceReading: Girl raises body and looks at silent/non-speaking brother, cue of collapse.
findings.explanation: Unanswering brother becomes wordless girl's look.

contexts.japanese: 少女は体を起こして、物言わぬ兄を見つめた。
contexts.english: The girl rises and looks wordlessly at the man.

findings.description: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.
findings.sourceReading: There is something addressing girl, then Zouken voice behind.
findings.explanation: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.

contexts.japanese: その少女に語りかけるものがある。
contexts.english: There's someone else she's speaking to, as well.

contexts.japanese: 「—多くの人間を殺したな、桜」
contexts.english: "...You've killed many people, Sakura."

findings.description: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou can touch Rin although he cannot remove her mud covering; 俺 understood from the voiced attempt and lifted Rin at page3.
findings.explanation: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.

contexts.japanese: 「っ……！　なんだこれ、遠坂には触れるのに、どうして……！」
contexts.english: "Rrgh...! What it this!? It can touch Tohsaka, so why can't I...!?"

contexts.japanese: 抱き上げても返事はない。
contexts.english: I lift her up, but she doesn't respond.

findings.description: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.
findings.sourceReading: Illya says she will take Sakura away, identifying herself as the agent.
findings.explanation: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.

contexts.japanese: 後の始末はわたしの役目だもん。サクラはわたしが連れて行くから、シロウはもう休んでいいよ」
contexts.english: It's my duty to take care of the rest. Sakura's going to take me away, so you can rest now."

findings.description: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura warns that Shirou might inadvertently fall under the eyes' effect. Rider explains that even limiting her magical energy would not reliably exclude him.
findings.explanation: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「こ、困りませんっ！　だいたいですね、ライダーの目は魔眼なんですよ？　ちょっとした弾みで魔術にかかっちゃったらどうするんですか！」
contexts.english: "I-it doesn't bother me at all! Besides, Rider's eyes are Mystic Eyes. What if she hits you with her magecraft on impulse!?"

contexts.japanese: 私本人が魔力をセーブしたところで、貴方を対象外にするのは難しい」
contexts.english: Even if I conserve my magical energy, it would be difficult to stop them from affecting you."

findings.description: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.
findings.sourceReading: Since she has little time, at least she wants him alone to go on living.
findings.explanation: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.

contexts.japanese: それならせめて、彼にだけは生きていてほしい。
contexts.english: She'd prefer to live the rest of it for him.

contexts.japanese: どうせ自分は長くない。
contexts.english: She doesn't have much time left, anyway.

findings.description: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou objects because either Rin or Illya will be injured if they fight.
findings.explanation: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「それもあるけど。遠坂、イリヤと戦ったらただじゃ済まないぞ。始めたらどっちかが必ず傷を負う。そういうのは嫌だ。俺は、もともと」
contexts.english: "That too. But Tohsaka, you won't get out unscathed if you fight her. You're bound to get hurt once you start. I don't want that to happen. To begin with—"

findings.description: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.
findings.sourceReading: As long as he serves as guide, Rin will give his plan priority; taking her keeps her from challenging Illya independently.
findings.explanation: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.

contexts.japanese: けどまあ、案内をする分には、遠坂は俺を優先してくれる。
contexts.english: Still, Tohsaka's doing me a favor by letting me guide her.

contexts.japanese: 放っておけばイリヤに戦いを挑む遠坂だが、ここで連れて行くと言えば、遠坂は大人しくしてくれるのだ。
contexts.english: If I let her go, she might fight Illya, but if she comes with me, then she'll behave.

findings.description: Something familiar in the Shadow becomes someone personally known.
findings.sourceReading: For an instant the Shadow seems like some familiar thing, association unfinished.
findings.explanation: Something familiar in the Shadow becomes someone personally known.

contexts.japanese: 何か、よく知っているモノに見えた、気がする。
contexts.english: I feel like I'm looking at someone I know well.

contexts.japanese: アレは間違いなくあの“黒い影”だ。
contexts.english: They definitely belong to the Shadow.

findings.description: How Berserker takes her plea becomes whether he heard it.
findings.sourceReading: Narration asks how he interpreted/received what she said before he advances roaring.
findings.explanation: How Berserker takes her plea becomes whether he heard it.

contexts.japanese: それをどう取ったのか。
contexts.english: Did he hear it?

findings.description: Grabbing his own chest becomes grabbing the attached Shadow.
findings.sourceReading: The giant grasps his chest and rips away the black Shadow together with his adhering flesh.
findings.explanation: Grabbing his own chest becomes grabbing the attached Shadow.

contexts.japanese: 片手で胸を掴み、バリ、という音をたてて、黒い影を引き剥がした。
contexts.english: With one hand, he grabbed the Shadow that latched to his chest and tore it off with a ripping sound.

contexts.japanese: —絡みついた部分ごと、中身が覗こうという勢いで、自らの身体を剥いだのだ。
contexts.english: —He literally tore his body open wherever the Shadow had grabbed him, exposing his innards.

findings.description: The English adds an order from Illya where the Japanese simply says Berserker stops. It makes her direct the halt, although the source leaves its immediate cause unstated.
findings.sourceReading: Illya vaguely realizes escape from her fear is impossible, and the narration then states that Berserker stops.
findings.explanation: The English adds an order from Illya where the Japanese simply says Berserker stops. It makes her direct the halt, although the source leaves its immediate cause unstated.

contexts.japanese: この不安、恐怖からは逃げられない、と少女は漠然と悟り—黒い巨人は足を止めた。
contexts.english: Vaguely realizing that there's no escape from this dread, from this fear, the girl orders the dark giant to stop.

findings.description: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail is merely a receptacle into which material is poured/which is filled.
findings.explanation: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯はただ注がれるだけのもの。
contexts.english: It is merely to fill the Grail.

findings.description: Assassin's defeated attack becomes a parry performed by Assassin. The exchange is reversed, although Archer's overall advantage remains clear; it concerns the skull-masked Assassin.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin cries out while retreating after Archer cuts down his all-out attack.
findings.explanation: Assassin's defeated attack becomes a parry performed by Assassin. The exchange is reversed, although Archer's overall advantage remains clear; it concerns the skull-masked Assassin.

contexts.japanese: 渾身の一撃を斬り落とされ、後退しながらアサシンは声を上げる。
contexts.english: Assassin desperately parries a shot, retreating.

contexts.japanese: 「ヌ—貴様、何故動ける……！？」
contexts.english: "Ngh... How can you move!?"

findings.description: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.
findings.sourceReading: Seeing clear blackness makes him wonder whether a black sun has fallen/come down.
findings.explanation: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.

contexts.japanese: こんなにハッキリ見えているのに暗いってコトは、黒い太陽でも落ちてきたのか。
contexts.english: It's so dark, even though I can see clearly. I must have fallen into a black sun.

findings.description: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.
findings.sourceReading: After the burst, the black Shadow melts away without trace, perhaps having exhausted its power.
findings.explanation: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.

contexts.japanese: ……消えていく。
contexts.english: ...I'm disappearing.

contexts.japanese: 今ので力を使い果たしたのか、“黒い影”は跡形もなく溶けていった。
contexts.english: The Shadow melts away without a trace, as if it's expended all its power.

findings.description: The women deciding argument cannot settle becomes Shirou thinking so.
findings.sourceReading: Seeing their verbal fight won't produce a decision, both women hand final choice to him.
findings.explanation: The women deciding argument cannot settle becomes Shirou thinking so.

contexts.japanese: 言い合いでは決着がつかないと見たのか、二人は最後の選択をこっちに振ってきた。
contexts.english: Just when I thought the argument was going nowhere, they both decide to turn the last choice over to me.

findings.description: Shirou still protests Rin's silence, but the English drops his reminder that she asked for his answer in the first place.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou complains that Rin has prompted his response and then fallen silent when he gives it.
findings.explanation: Shirou still protests Rin's silence, but the English drops his reminder that she asked for his answer in the first place.

contexts.japanese: 「遠坂？　おい、人に話ふっといて無視するな」
contexts.english: "Tohsaka? Hey, don't ignore me when I'm talking to you."

findings.description: A look like one used to blame the socially vulnerable becomes a look reserved for society's dregs.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou feels Rin's gaze resembles one condemning a socially disadvantaged or weak person.
findings.explanation: A look like one used to blame the socially vulnerable becomes a look reserved for society's dregs.

contexts.japanese: その目がこう、いかにも社会的弱者を責めるようで胃が痛い。
contexts.english: She's giving me a wince-inducing look reserved for the utter dregs of society.

findings.description: Covers already kicked away during sleep become Shirou kicking them off after waking.
findings.sourceReading: He wakes from difficult sleep with sweat-heavy pajamas and the quilt already kicked away.
findings.explanation: Covers already kicked away during sleep become Shirou kicking them off after waking.

contexts.japanese: 寝巻きは汗を吸って重く、掛け布団は蹴り飛ばされている。
contexts.english: My pajamas are heavy with sweat. I kick off the covers.

findings.description: Shirou gripping his immobile left arm becomes trying to clench the immobile left hand.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou uses his other hand to grip/clutch the left arm that will not move.
findings.explanation: Shirou gripping his immobile left arm becomes trying to clench the immobile left hand.

contexts.japanese: ……動かない左腕を握り締める。
contexts.english: ...I try to clench my unmoving left hand.

findings.description: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou could not answer because he himself had noticed what Rider's no-matter-what condition points toward.
findings.explanation: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.

contexts.japanese: 答えを言えなかったのは、気付いてしまったからだ。
contexts.english: She noticed that I couldn't give her a clear answer.

findings.description: The expanding Shadow avoiding Shirou's depression becomes Shirou evading it in a ditch.
findings.sourceReading: Uneven ground shelters Shirou in a hollow: the Shadow passes around/avoids him, except for the exposed left arm.
findings.explanation: The expanding Shadow avoiding Shirou's depression becomes Shirou evading it in a ditch.

contexts.japanese: 広がった黒い影は窪みにいた衛宮士郎を避けて通った。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya evaded the Shadow in a ditch.

contexts.japanese: 森の地面が凹凸だった事が幸いしたのだ。
contexts.english: He was fortunate that the forest terrain is filled with crags and valleys.

findings.description: The English makes Sakura imagine injuring Shirou herself. The Japanese gives her a disturbing wish that he be injured, while leaving its cause unspecified.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura recalls wishing that Shirou would sustain an injury severe enough to keep him indoors. The thought does not specify who would cause it.
findings.explanation: The English makes Sakura imagine injuring Shirou herself. The Japanese gives her a disturbing wish that he be injured, while leaving its cause unspecified.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎が外に出られないぐらいの怪我をすれば、もう危ない目にあわなくてすむ、と。
contexts.english: If she injured Shirou Emiya so that he couldn't go outside, then he wouldn't be in danger anymore.

findings.description: The Japanese says Shirou suffered an injury independently of Sakura’s wish. The English explicitly says she hurt him. This adds an agent to the clause without settling the wider cause of the injury.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女の願いとは関係なく separates the actual injury from her earlier wish; 衛宮士郎は傷を負った does not explicitly name Sakura as the actor who inflicted it.
findings.explanation: The Japanese says Shirou suffered an injury independently of Sakura’s wish. The English explicitly says she hurt him. This adds an agent to the clause without settling the wider cause of the injury.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の願いとは関係なく、衛宮士郎は傷を負った。
contexts.english: And now, she'd hurt Shirou Emiya in a way that had nothing to do with her wish.

findings.description: Archer being brought to the church near death becomes Archer bringing Shirou there.
findings.sourceReading: After the completed transplant Archer vanishes; he was already moribund when he himself was transported there, and endured through the procedure via Independent Action.
findings.explanation: Archer being brought to the church near death becomes Archer bringing Shirou there.

contexts.japanese: 「移植が済んだ後、消滅した。ここに運ばれた時点で死に体だったのだが、よくも終わるまで保ったものだ。アーチャーの持つ単独行動故だろうがな」
contexts.english: "After the transplant, he disappeared. He was already on the verge of death when he brought you here. I'm surprised he lasted so long. It must be thanks to his Independent Action ability."

findings.description: Shirou asks the priest to pray for him; English has Shirou undertake the prayer himself. The wish survives, but the priest-directed banter loses its specific target.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou asks Father Kotomine to pray that there will be no fourth occasion, combining thanks with a pointed request suited to a priest.
findings.explanation: Shirou asks the priest to pray for him; English has Shirou undertake the prayer himself. The wish survives, but the priest-directed banter loses its specific target.

contexts.japanese: ……また世話になった、言峰神父。出来れば四度目がないよう祈っててくれ」
contexts.english: ...You helped me out again, Father Kotomine. I'll pray that it doesn't happen a fourth time."

findings.description: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.
findings.sourceReading: Rin falsely paraphrases Illya as refusing the house because Emiya himself is not dependable, preferring her secure castle.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.

contexts.japanese: 「言ってるじゃない。衛宮くんの家に行かないのは、衛宮くんが頼りにならないからでしょ？　だから安心できる自分の城に戻るって言ってるんじゃない」
contexts.english: "You're saying it right now. You don't want to go to Emiya's house because you don't want to rely on him, right? You'd feel better back at your own castle."

findings.description: The English adds amusement at Gilgamesh's own wording. The Japanese keeps his mockery directed at Kirei's claim to have no desires.
findings.sourceReading: The final fragment specifies the priest's words that Gilgamesh appears to mock: his profession of having no desires.
findings.explanation: The English adds amusement at Gilgamesh's own wording. The Japanese keeps his mockery directed at Kirei's claim to have no desires.

contexts.japanese: 望みはない、と告げた言葉をからかうように。
contexts.english: as well as his own choice of "free of desire."

findings.description: The Grail answering its holder's wishes becomes the Grail responding to its own wishes.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail is only a machine that answers the user's own desire and manufactures acceptable answers to the user's questions.
findings.explanation: The Grail answering its holder's wishes becomes the Grail responding to its own wishes.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯は己が望みに応えるだけのもの。
contexts.english: The Holy Grail should respond to its own wishes.

findings.description: A father valuing an excellent son becomes a son excelling at making his father happy.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei reasons that a child's excellence is naturally a parental joy, so his father likely values him for that excellence.
findings.explanation: A father valuing an excellent son becomes a son excelling at making his father happy.

contexts.japanese: 息子が優れているのは、親として喜ぶ事だ。だからこの男は自分を重宝するのだろう。
contexts.english: The son excelled at making his father happy. That was probably why his father valued him so.

findings.description: The voices of common sense, morality and justice judging evil become Kirei's own conclusion.
findings.sourceReading: Conventional authorities—common sense, moral instruction and justice—collectively declare that such evil should not exist.
findings.explanation: The voices of common sense, morality and justice judging evil become Kirei's own conclusion.

contexts.japanese: それらが全て、悪は在ってはならぬモノと断定する。
contexts.english: He concluded that such evil could not, should not exist.

findings.description: The Grail trying to exist becomes Kirei wanting to let it exist.
findings.sourceReading: Ten years earlier he pursued the Grail because it itself was trying to come into existence/birth.
findings.explanation: The Grail trying to exist becomes Kirei wanting to let it exist.

contexts.japanese: 十年前聖杯を求めたのも、聖杯が在ろうとしたからだ。
contexts.english: Ten years ago, I sought it out because I wanted to let it exist as it is.

findings.description: Blessing whatever seeks birth becomes blessing the Grail for trying to give birth.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever the Grail may be, Kirei blesses the thing that is attempting to be born; he defines this as his vocation.
findings.explanation: Blessing whatever seeks birth becomes blessing the Grail for trying to give birth.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯がなんであれ、生まれ出でようとするモノを祝福する。それが私の仕事だからな」
contexts.english: No matter what the Holy Grail may be, I bless it for trying to give birth. That is my task."

findings.description: Kirei's interest in this war's outcome becomes interest in the ending of Kirei himself.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei Kotomine, the man who finds pleasure only in others' suffering, is interested in the present conclusion/outcome.
findings.explanation: Kirei's interest in this war's outcome becomes interest in the ending of Kirei himself.

contexts.japanese: 他者の苦しみにしか悦びを見出せなかった言峰綺礼は、此度の結末に関心を持っている。
contexts.english: He is interested in Kirei Kotomine's conclusion—in the end of a man who can only find happiness in the suffering of others.

findings.description: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.
findings.sourceReading: After the terse greeting, Illya walks to the living room behind/following Tohsaka.
findings.explanation: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは遠坂の後に付いて居間へ歩いていく。
contexts.english: Illya leaves Tohsaka and walks to the living room.

findings.description: Shirou not believing appearance is his reason becomes not being influenced on purpose.
findings.sourceReading: He does not think he is simply fooled by Illya's looks, but admits that his hesitation itself proves her appearance affects him.
findings.explanation: Shirou not believing appearance is his reason becomes not being influenced on purpose.

contexts.japanese: 自分ではそんな気はしないが、躊躇っている時点であの子の外見に影響されているんだから。
contexts.english: It's not like I'm doing it on purpose, but maybe what she looks like is getting to me.

findings.description: Shirou lacking the nerve to open the church door becomes opening it.
findings.sourceReading: Although he came at Saber's urging, Shirou cannot summon the spirit to push open the door and question Kirei about ten years ago.
findings.explanation: Shirou lacking the nerve to open the church door becomes opening it.

contexts.japanese: あの扉を押し開け、神父に十年前の出来事を尋ねる気概が生まれない。
contexts.english: As I push on the door, I don't feel particularly motivated to ask the priest about what happened ten years ago.

findings.description: Shirou's muscles locking when the man stands becomes admiration of firm, strong movement. Shirou still freezes later as the hand approaches his neck.
findings.sourceReading: The man's act of standing instantly makes Shirou's muscles lock. The following approach provokes an expectation of being killed.
findings.explanation: Shirou's muscles locking when the man stands becomes admiration of firm, strong movement. Shirou still freezes later as the hand approaches his neck.

contexts.japanese: その動作だけで、筋肉という筋肉が硬直した。
contexts.english: are firm and strong.

contexts.japanese: 瞬間。
contexts.english: Just from a glance, I can tell that his movements

findings.description: Shirou recognizing the man's withdrawal as normal becomes agreeing that the man is not wrong.
findings.sourceReading: The man moves away; Shirou thinks that distancing is the natural outcome and that his own death panic was abnormal.
findings.explanation: Shirou recognizing the man's withdrawal as normal becomes agreeing that the man is not wrong.

contexts.japanese: そう、それが当然だ。
contexts.english: I can't say he's wrong.

findings.description: Crawling fugitives become petitioners shot after turning their backs.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu made pleading Masters crawl, then put a gun to the skulls of those trying to flee and pulled the trigger.
findings.explanation: Crawling fugitives become petitioners shot after turning their backs.

contexts.japanese: ヤツは的確であり、周到であり、蛮勇であり、無情だった。敵にかける情けなどない。殺すと決めればただ殺した。サーヴァントを屠り、助けを請うマスターを這わせ、逃げようとする頭蓋に銃口を当てて引き金を引いた。殺した後の感慨もない。強さを誇る優越も、消えた弱者への罪悪もない」
contexts.english: He was precise, meticulous, predatory, and ruthless. He had no mercy for his enemies. Once he decided to kill someone, they would die. He butchered Servants and allowed their Masters to beg for their lives only to pull the trigger once their backs were turned. He felt nothing after each kill. He felt neither pride in his own dominance nor guilt for the fallen."

findings.description: The old families' comparison becomes Kirei's comparison of families.
findings.sourceReading: Makiri and Einzbern apparently regarded Kirei and Kiritsugu as the same kind, although the two saw each other as natural enemies.
findings.explanation: The old families' comparison becomes Kirei's comparison of families.

contexts.japanese: 「当然だ。ヤツと私は両極に位置していた。私とあの男は生まれついての仇敵だ。マキリやアインツベルンには同類として映ったらしいが、私たちは共に、互いを天敵だと認識していた」
contexts.english: "Naturally. We stood at opposite extremes. We were born to be each other's nemeses. You might compare us to the Makiris and the Einzberns, but we both understood each other as natural enemies."

findings.description: Shirou's two extremes and ordinary wounded human become avoidance versus embracing humanity.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou asks whether Kirei is different: neither one who suffers no wounds nor one who has nothing but wounds, but an ordinary human who is wounded when cut; is priesthood the difference from Kiritsugu?
findings.explanation: Shirou's two extremes and ordinary wounded human become avoidance versus embracing humanity.

contexts.japanese: 「……じゃあ、アンタは違うのか。傷を負わないのでもなく、傷しかないのでもない。斬られれば傷を負う、まっとうな人間だって。アンタは神父だから、そこが切嗣とは違うと……？」
contexts.english: "...And you're different? He was someone who avoided getting hurt. While you say you were hurt, as you took a path embracing humanity. Being a priest made you different from Kiritsugu...?"

findings.description: Kirei's fury becomes Kiritsugu's fury.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says that if there was a moment when he felt fury toward Kiritsugu, it was precisely when Kiritsugu betrayed himself at the end.
findings.explanation: Kirei's fury becomes Kiritsugu's fury.

contexts.japanese: ……ヤツに憤怒を覚えたといえば、まさしくあの瞬間だったろう。
contexts.english: He must have been so enraged in that moment.

findings.description: A comparison to a brutal historical age becomes Einzbern's own thousand-year killing campaign.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei invokes the old age when atrocities could pass under the banner of reclaiming the Holy Land, then says Einzbern's unbroken medieval persistence exceeds the human domain.
findings.explanation: A comparison to a brutal historical age becomes Einzbern's own thousand-year killing campaign.

contexts.japanese: 一千年だぞ？　聖地奪還という使命を盾に殺して殺して殺し尽くすなどという異次元の蛮行がまかり通った昔、中世より連綿と続いた、人の領域など逸脱した狂気の沙汰だ。
contexts.english: One thousand years. In the name of their quest, they have killed and killed and killed, committing atrocities beyond imagination, clinging to their inhuman madness since the Middle Ages.

findings.description: Obsession no human can confront becomes obsession not just anyone can possess.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou has no words because an obsession lasting centuries is not something a human being can stand against or confront.
findings.explanation: Obsession no human can confront becomes obsession not just anyone can possess.

contexts.japanese: 何百年もの間続く執念なんて、それは人が対峙できるものではないからだ。
contexts.english: Not just anyone can obsess over a single goal for hundreds of years.

findings.description: Risking Shirou's own life each night becomes weighing lives in general.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei tells Shirou, like Kiritsugu, to put his own life on the scales night after night and lure out his target.
findings.explanation: Risking Shirou's own life each night becomes weighing lives in general.

contexts.japanese: 「十分だ。それがおまえの戦う意義ならば、死を賭して戦うがいい。長引けばそれだけ犠牲者は出る。切嗣と同じよう、夜毎己が命を秤にかけて標的を誘き寄せろ」
contexts.english: "That is sufficient. If that is what drives you, then fight like your life depends on it. The longer it lasts, the more victims there will be. Do as Kiritsugu did and weigh lives on a balance, all to lure out your objective."

findings.description: Shirou turning his back on Kirei becomes Kirei turning his back on Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou turns his back on the priest as he concludes he has nothing left to ask.
findings.explanation: Shirou turning his back on Kirei becomes Kirei turning his back on Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 神父に背を向ける。
contexts.english: The priest turns his back on me.

findings.description: Hesitation disappearing when Shirou nearly died becomes disappearing when he risked his life.
findings.sourceReading: In both patrol branches Shirou says his hesitation vanished when he was on the verge of death.
findings.explanation: Hesitation disappearing when Shirou nearly died becomes disappearing when he risked his life.

contexts.japanese: 躊躇いは死にかけた時に消えている。
contexts.english: Any hesitation disappeared the moment I risked my life.

contexts.japanese: 躊躇いは死にかけた時に消えている。
contexts.english: Any hesitation disappeared the moment I risked my life.

findings.description: A body that will not move and a mind that issues no command become a body disobeying its mind.
findings.sourceReading: His body will not move, and his head will not tell it what to do next: both thought and action are arrested.
findings.explanation: A body that will not move and a mind that issues no command become a body disobeying its mind.

contexts.japanese: なのに体は動かず、頭は次の行動を命じてくれない。
contexts.english: But now, my body won't listen to my brain.

contexts.japanese: なのに体は動かず、頭は次の行動を命じてくれない。
contexts.english: But now, my body won't listen to my brain.

findings.description: The victim not surviving if they remain still becomes doubt that the pair can help.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says that if things continue this way, the attacked person will not be saved, despite not knowing what happened.
findings.explanation: The victim not surviving if they remain still becomes doubt that the pair can help.

contexts.japanese: 「悲鳴が止みました。感じ取れる気配も消えかけています。何が起きたかは判りませんが、このままでは襲われた者は助からないでしょう」
contexts.english: "The scream stopped. The presence we sensed is fading. I don't know what just happened, but I doubt we'll be able to help whoever was attacked."

findings.description: Shinto being easier for a hostile Master to operate in becomes easier for Shirou to deal with them there.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou chooses Shinto because a Master planning something dangerous would find it easier to act there than in Miyama.
findings.explanation: Shinto being easier for a hostile Master to operate in becomes easier for Shirou to deal with them there.

contexts.japanese: 「新都に行こう。物騒な事を企んでいるマスターがいるとしたら、深山より新都の方がやりやすいだろうからな」
contexts.english: "Let's go to Shinto. If any of the Masters is up to no good, then it'll be easier to deal with them there."

findings.description: Shirou's skill failing to match his plan becomes a shared failure to account for his skill.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says Shirou's action itself was right; if there was a shortcoming, only his ability failed to keep pace with his idea.
findings.explanation: Shirou's skill failing to match his plan becomes a shared failure to account for his skill.

contexts.japanese: 「いえ、マスターの行動自体は正しい。失点があるとしたら、シロウの技量が考えに付いてこなかっただけでしょう。
contexts.english: "No, Master, your actions were correct. If a mistake was made, it was that we failed to account for your skill level.

findings.description: Shinji not running to wounded Rider becomes running to her.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji screams without going over to Rider, whose abdomen has been cut and who is badly wounded.
findings.explanation: Shinji not running to wounded Rider becomes running to her.

contexts.japanese: 腹を裂かれ、深手を負ったライダーに駆け寄ることなく慎二が叫ぶ。
contexts.english: Shinji runs over to Rider and screams at her. She's sprawled on the ground, her belly cut open.

findings.description: A treasure wasted on Shinji becomes Shinji himself being useless.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says Rider was wasted in Shinji's hands—宝の持ち腐れ, possession of a treasure one cannot use.
findings.explanation: A treasure wasted on Shinji becomes Shinji himself being useless.

contexts.japanese: 「そこまでだ。どうやらおまえでは宝の持ち腐れだったようじゃな、慎二」
contexts.english: "Enough. It seems you weren't useful after all, Shinji."

findings.description: Running up to the old man becomes scrambling over him.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji runs to Zouken as if clinging to him for protection.
findings.explanation: Running up to the old man becomes scrambling over him.

contexts.japanese: 慎二は縋るように老人に駆け寄る。
contexts.english: Shinji scrambles over the old man as if clinging to his feet.

findings.description: Zouken's account of learning about the Grail and arranging his grandson's contract becomes an account centered on Shinji's actions. The preceding admission that Zouken selected him survives, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of Zouken's agency.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says he learned the Grail would appear and had his grandson contract in his place. He then addresses Shirou as someone belonging to a magical lineage.
findings.explanation: Zouken's account of learning about the Grail and arranging his grandson's contract becomes an account centered on Shinji's actions. The preceding admission that Zouken selected him survives, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of Zouken's agency.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯が現れると知り、ワシではなく孫にサーヴァントと契約させたのだ。おぬしとて魔道を究める血の末席。
contexts.english: When he learned of the Holy Grail, he—not I—made a contract with a Servant. Like you, he is the last of a line walking the ways of the wise.

findings.description: Uncertainty about Zouken's feelings toward the Tohsakas becomes amusement at their presumed feelings. This supplies a target for his laughter that the Japanese leaves open.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou cannot tell what feelings Zouken holds toward the Tohsaka family as Zouken laughs with apparent pleasure.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty about Zouken's feelings toward the Tohsakas becomes amusement at their presumed feelings. This supplies a target for his laughter that the Japanese leaves open.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の家にどんな感情を抱いているのか、間桐臓硯は愉快そうに哄笑する。
contexts.english: Zouken Matou laughs in amusement at whatever the Tohsaka family must be feeling.

findings.description: Zouken's account of sending Sakura to another family becomes an account of the Matous adopting someone. The stated obstacle also changes from the prospective adoptee's lack of circuits to the family's lack of circuits to pass on.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says the unselected sibling could have been sent out for adoption, but no receiving family would want someone without circuits. The surrounding questions identify Sakura as the person under discussion.
findings.explanation: Zouken's account of sending Sakura to another family becomes an account of the Matous adopting someone. The stated obstacle also changes from the prospective adoptee's lack of circuits to the family's lack of circuits to pass on.

contexts.japanese: 兄妹など最たるものだ。後継ぎは二人もいらぬ。間桐の名が廃れていなければ養子にでも出したのだが、魔術回路がないのでは貰い手などおるまい」
contexts.english: That's doubly so for siblings. There is no need for two heirs. If the Matou name hadn't declined, then we might have been able to adopt someone, but we don't have any Magic Circuits to pass on to begin with."

findings.description: Shirou starting to run after handing over the woman becomes Saber starting to run.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou entrusts the woman to Saber and sets off running; she then announces she will lead and moves ahead.
findings.explanation: Shirou starting to run after handing over the woman becomes Saber starting to run.

contexts.japanese: 女性をセイバーに預けて走り出す。
contexts.english: Saber takes the woman and starts running.

findings.description: A little carelessness causing a repeat becomes Shirou recklessly repeating the event.
findings.sourceReading: Saber warns that even slight carelessness could cause last night's near-fatal situation to recur.
findings.explanation: A little carelessness causing a repeat becomes Shirou recklessly repeating the event.

contexts.japanese: 「それで、何をされたのですかシロウ……！　貴方の傷はまだ完治してはいない。少しの油断で昨夜の繰り返しになるのだと、貴方自身も判っている筈です……！」
contexts.english: "What did he do to you, Shirou!? Your wounds aren't fully healed yet. You know what will happen if you're reckless enough to repeat what happened last night!"

findings.description: Shirou's cheeks loosening into a smile becomes his cheeks burning.
findings.sourceReading: Saber's indignant face is so fresh to Shirou that his expression involuntarily softens into another smile.
findings.explanation: Shirou's cheeks loosening into a smile becomes his cheeks burning.

contexts.japanese: そう抗議する顔すら新鮮で、つい頬が緩んでしまう。
contexts.english: Even her indignation is amusing, and my cheeks start burning.

findings.description: A patrol that amounts to relying on chance becomes an idea that happened to seem good to Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Patrolling on foot is like hoping for coincidence, although Saber calls the method dangerous but reliable.
findings.explanation: A patrol that amounts to relying on chance becomes an idea that happened to seem good to Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 偶然に期待するようなものだが、セイバー曰く『危険ではあるが確実』な手なのだそうだ。
contexts.english: It just happened to seem like a good idea to me, but Saber said that it was a "risky but certain" choice.

findings.description: Shirou being unable to raise his cup becomes everyone refusing to drink.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou cannot bring himself to drink because even the sound of the teacup seems likely to echo; his hot green tea has gone cold.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unable to raise his cup becomes everyone refusing to drink.

contexts.japanese: お茶を飲もうにも湯飲みの音さえ響きそうで飲めず、熱い緑茶はとっくに冷めきっていた。
contexts.english: They don't even drink the tea to avoid making a sipping sound, leaving the hot tea to go cold.

findings.description: Sakura's claim that Shirou and Rin are unrelated becomes Rin being unrelated to both Sakura and Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura insists that Senpai and that person have nothing to do with each other, while she is the one who is here, repeating why in distress.
findings.explanation: Sakura's claim that Shirou and Rin are unrelated becomes Rin being unrelated to both Sakura and Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「どうして、遠坂先輩がここに来るんですか。そんなのおかしいです。だってぜんぜん関係ない。ここにいるのはわたしで、先輩とあの人はぜんぜん関係ないのに、どうして」
contexts.english: "Why was she here? It's a little strange. She has nothing to do with us. Not me, or you, so why?"

findings.description: Sakura holding her own body disappears from the intact narration.
findings.sourceReading: With head lowered, Sakura stays still while pressing or holding her body, before the damaged later line elaborates her self-embrace.
findings.explanation: Sakura holding her own body disappears from the intact narration.

contexts.japanese: 俯いたまま、桜はじっと体を押さえる。
contexts.english: Sakura suddenly goes still, looking downcast.

findings.description: An obsession Shirou cannot contend with becomes one he cannot imagine.
findings.sourceReading: Einzbern's thousand-year fixation is not something Shirou can do anything about or stand against.
findings.explanation: An obsession Shirou cannot contend with becomes one he cannot imagine.

contexts.japanese: その執念は俺がどうこうできるものじゃない。
contexts.english: I can't even begin to imagine that level of obsession.

findings.description: Kirei already standing immediately before Shirou becomes Shirou taking position before Kirei.
findings.sourceReading: When Shirou reluctantly turns around, the priest is already standing right in front of him.
findings.explanation: Kirei already standing immediately before Shirou becomes Shirou taking position before Kirei.

contexts.japanese: 渋々と振り返ると、神父は俺のすぐ目の前に立っていた。
contexts.english: I reluctantly turn back and stand in front of the priest.

findings.description: Shirou's inability to make Saber dematerialize becomes his failure to learn to become a ghost.
findings.sourceReading: He understands that Servants can become spirit bodies, but unfortunately he cannot make or allow Saber to perform that feat.
findings.explanation: Shirou's inability to make Saber dematerialize becomes his failure to learn to become a ghost.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントは霊体になれるらしいが、生憎俺にはそんな芸当はさせられない。
contexts.english: Apparently, Servants can turn into invisible ghosts, but alas, I never learned how do to that trick.

findings.description: Shirou's imagined example of an unacceptable tactic becomes a prediction reported from Kotomine. Saber's reply still rejects the tactic, making the English transition less direct.
findings.sourceReading: Recalling the priest's explanation, Shirou imagines involving uninvolved non-Masters and causing a disaster as examples of the means he fears Saber might use.
findings.explanation: Shirou's imagined example of an unacceptable tactic becomes a prediction reported from Kotomine. Saber's reply still rejects the tactic, making the English transition less direct.

contexts.japanese: マスターでもない無関係の人間を巻き込んで、十年前のあの日のような惨状を起こすような—
contexts.english: He said that people who have nothing to do with Masters would be drawn into the conflict, and the tragedy of ten years ago would be repeated...

findings.description: Shirou looking at his dead father becomes Kiritsugu looking at the moon.
findings.sourceReading: The child silently looks up at the winter moon and the man who had been his father, now entered into a long sleep.
findings.explanation: Shirou looking at his dead father becomes Kiritsugu looking at the moon.

contexts.japanese: 何をするでもなく、冬の月と、長い眠りに入った、父親だった人を見上げていた。
contexts.english: On a winter night, the man I called my father looked up at the moon and entered a long sleep.

findings.description: The account reaching the present becomes something unconscious Shirou remembers.
findings.sourceReading: Rin carried the still-unconscious Shirou home, and that sequence brings the account to the present.
findings.explanation: The account reaching the present becomes something unconscious Shirou remembers.

contexts.japanese: 傷は治ったものの意識が戻らない俺をここまで運んで、あとは今に至るという訳だとか。
contexts.english: I was still unconscious, so Tohsaka brought me here and the rest was as I remember it.

findings.description: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she can no longer perform the feat of reviving someone near death; Shirou himself somehow dealt with his scattered insides.
findings.explanation: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.

contexts.japanese: 「まさか。死にかけてる人間を蘇生させる、なんて芸当は、もうわたしには出来ない。衛宮士郎は自分でぶっ飛んだ中身をどうにかしたのよ」
contexts.english: "No way. I can't revive someone on the verge of death. What was I supposed to do about your intestines scattered on the pavement?"

findings.description: Knowing another Master's identity as an offensive advantage becomes one's own exposure.
findings.sourceReading: Conversely, if a Master knows who another Master is, that Master can certainly launch a surprise attack.
findings.explanation: Knowing another Master's identity as an offensive advantage becomes one's own exposure.

contexts.japanese: 逆に誰がマスターかを知っていれば、確実に奇襲ができる。
contexts.english: Conversely, if the other Masters know who you are, you're just asking to be ambushed.

findings.description: The Shirou–Saber team being half-fledged becomes Saber herself half as effective.
findings.sourceReading: Saber is faultless, but her Master drags the side down, leaving their unit half-fledged.
findings.explanation: The Shirou–Saber team being half-fledged becomes Saber herself half as effective.

contexts.japanese: で、そっちはサーヴァントは申し分ないけど、マスターが足ひっぱってやっぱり半人前。ほら、合わせれば丁度いいわ」
contexts.english: And while your Servant is superb, her Master's dragging her down, making her half as effective. See? Put the two of us together and you've got a whole."

findings.description: Archer's defeat becomes merely being hurt.
findings.sourceReading: Rin offers to wipe the slate clean over Archer having been defeated and to teach Shirou Master knowledge.
findings.explanation: Archer's defeat becomes merely being hurt.

contexts.japanese: 「同盟の代価ぐらいは払うわ。アーチャーを倒されたコトはチャラにしてあげて、マスターとしての知識も教えてあげる。ああ、あと暇があれば衛宮くんの魔術の腕を見てあげてもいいけど、どう？」
contexts.english: "I'll make it worth your while. I'll let you off for getting Archer hurt, and teach you what you need to know to be a Master. Oh, and if we have time, I can even give you some pointers on your magecraft. Deal?"

findings.description: Illya running to the shed while shouting becomes stomping toward it.
findings.sourceReading: Still shouting at Sakura, Illya runs toward the shed.
findings.explanation: Illya running to the shed while shouting becomes stomping toward it.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは怒鳴りながら土蔵へ走っていく。
contexts.english: Illya fumes at Sakura as she stomps over to the shed.

findings.description: The knight running with the horse and king becomes running toward Saber.
findings.sourceReading: The knight is running through the battlefield while leading the wounded white horse carrying the king.
findings.explanation: The knight running with the horse and king becomes running toward Saber.

contexts.japanese: 騎士は走っていた。
contexts.english: The knight runs to her.

findings.description: The king's admiration of Bedivere becomes the king's voice being admirable.
findings.sourceReading: The king murmurs as though impressed by Bedivere's supposed knowledge.
findings.explanation: The king's admiration of Bedivere becomes the king's voice being admirable.

contexts.japanese: 王は感心するように呟く。
contexts.english: The king's soft voice is admirable.

findings.description: The king's exceptionally long duty becomes the knight's burden.
findings.sourceReading: Bedivere accepts that the king's end has come and that her exceedingly long responsibility is now finished.
findings.explanation: The king's exceptionally long duty becomes the knight's burden.

contexts.japanese: その、あまりに長かった責務が、ここにこうして終わったのだと。
contexts.english: The responsibilities that had so long burdened the knight finally come to an end.

findings.description: Sakura's buoyant voice becomes her body bouncing.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura speaks in a voice that seems to bounce with liveliness.
findings.explanation: Sakura's buoyant voice becomes her body bouncing.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-00:page47:1
contexts.japanese: 弾むような声で桜は言う。
contexts.english: Sakura is practically bouncing with excitement.

findings.description: Recognizing mana-permeable locations becomes seeking places for mana to pass.
findings.sourceReading: Even after reading the blueprint, the main gain is knowing which parts readily conduct magical energy.
findings.explanation: Recognizing mana-permeable locations becomes seeking places for mana to pass.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-03:page20:1
contexts.japanese: だから設計図なんてものを読みとるのは無駄な手間だし、読みとったところで出来る事といったら魔力の通りやすい箇所が判る程度の話。
contexts.english: That's why reading blueprints is a waste of time, and even that only helps seek out areas for magical energy to pass through.

findings.description: Taiga ignoring the teacher-student status difference becomes anger directed at either teachers or students.
findings.sourceReading: When Taiga says she will get angry, she follows through regardless of the other person being a student and regardless of her own position as teacher.
findings.explanation: Taiga ignoring the teacher-student status difference becomes anger directed at either teachers or students.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-03:page74:1
contexts.japanese: 藤ねえは怒るといったら怒る人だ。相手が生徒だろうが自分が教師だろうが関係ない。
contexts.english: When Fuji-nee says she gets mad, she gets mad. Doesn't matter if it's with a teacher or a student.

findings.description: The English attaches Sakura's pride to her preceding statement and omits her chest-puffing pose. It preserves her confidence but loses the physical comedy.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura puffs out her chest with pride after describing her gas-valve checks.
findings.explanation: The English attaches Sakura's pride to her preceding statement and omits her chest-puffing pose. It preserves her confidence but loses the physical comedy.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-06:page34:1
contexts.japanese: えっへん、と胸をはる桜。
contexts.english: Sakura proudly proclaims.

findings.description: Mutually parting at the school gate becomes Shirou seeing Sakura off.
findings.sourceReading: As usual, Shirou and Sakura part at the school gate because she goes to morning kyudo practice.
findings.explanation: Mutually parting at the school gate becomes Shirou seeing Sakura off.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-06:page42:1
contexts.japanese: 校門で桜と別れるのもいつも通り。
contexts.english: I see Sakura off at the school gate as usual.

findings.description: Shirou folding his body forward becomes his back arching.
findings.sourceReading: To withstand dizziness that could make him faint, Shirou bends his body into a く shape.
findings.explanation: Shirou folding his body forward becomes his back arching.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page33:1
contexts.japanese: そのまま気を失いかねない目眩に、体をくの字に曲げて耐えた。
contexts.english: My back arches in an effort to keep me from passing out.

findings.description: The artwork analogy becomes malformed and assigns intention to a paintbrush.
findings.sourceReading: Strengthening resembles adding a brushstroke to a completed artwork; a stroke meant to reinforce it may instead reduce the work's value.
findings.explanation: The artwork analogy becomes malformed and assigns intention to a paintbrush.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page35:1
contexts.japanese: 俺がやっている事は、完成した芸術品に筆を加える事に似ている。
contexts.english: What I'm attempting to do is like adding an extra brushwork to a completed work of art.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page36:1
contexts.japanese: 補強する筈の筆が、芸術品そのものの価値を下げる事もある、という事だ。
contexts.english: The paintbrush, hoping to improve, may actually devalue the work instead.

findings.description: The English keeps the joke about excessive composure but removes Taiga's reference to indulging her own tastes. Her implied credit for Shirou's temperament becomes criticism of his excess.
findings.sourceReading: Taiga says Shirou is so composed that even she wonders whether she has indulged her own tastes too much; the boast implies influence over how he has turned out.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the joke about excessive composure but removes Taiga's reference to indulging her own tastes. Her implied credit for Shirou's temperament becomes criticism of his excess.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page45:1
contexts.japanese: 「当然です。士郎はわたしでもちょっと趣味に走りすぎたかっていうぐらい落ち着いてるんだから」
contexts.english: "Of course. Even from my point of view, Shirou is really composed. So much so, he might be overdoing it."

findings.description: Taiga's self-satisfied nod becomes a disapproving head shake.
findings.sourceReading: Calling the situation troublesome, Taiga nods and keeps eating after cheerfully announcing she will tell Ayako.
findings.explanation: Taiga's self-satisfied nod becomes a disapproving head shake.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page63:1
contexts.japanese: こまったもんだ、と頷いてごはんを食べる藤ねえ。
contexts.english: Fuji-nee shakes her head disapprovingly as she eats.

findings.description: Shirou's private loss of taste becomes a general atypical dinner and loss of appetite.
findings.sourceReading: Dinner was normal for everyone except Shirou; distracted by the changing-room incident, he could not even tell how the food tasted.
findings.explanation: Shirou's private loss of taste becomes a general atypical dinner and loss of appetite.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page0:1
contexts.japanese: 俺以外は概ねいつも通りの夕食だったと思う。
contexts.english: It was probably a typical dinner...except it didn't feel that way.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page0:1
contexts.japanese: こっちはと言うと、脱衣場での一件がちらついてメシの味さえ分からなかった。
contexts.english: I've lost my appetite since the incident in the bathroom.

findings.description: Saber blaming her own discourtesy becomes agreeing with Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Saber infers that training unarmored was disrespectful and says she herself was thoughtless.
findings.explanation: Saber blaming her own discourtesy becomes agreeing with Shirou.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-02:page8:1
contexts.japanese: 「はあ。武装している方がいい、というのでしたら着替えますが。……そうですね、私がどうかしていました。
contexts.english: "Huh. If you prefer me armored, I can change. You are right...I was not thinking.

findings.description: Shirou's exhaustion becomes shared exhaustion with Saber.
findings.sourceReading: The floor is slippery with sweat and Shirou is exhausted; this is not an extreme-condition simulation.
findings.explanation: Shirou's exhaustion becomes shared exhaustion with Saber.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-02:page36:1
contexts.japanese: 床も汗で滑りやすくなっている。極限状態での模擬戦でもなし、疲労困憊して足場も不確か—などという状態では意味がありません」
contexts.english: The floor is slippery with sweat. We are not trying to carry out mock battles in extreme situations, so there is no point in carrying on while we are exhausted and on unstable footing."

findings.description: Saber's lack of sweat becomes lack of hard breathing.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou is sweaty enough to scatter drops across the floor, while Saber has not shed a single drop of sweat.
findings.explanation: Saber's lack of sweat becomes lack of hard breathing.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-02:page53:1
contexts.japanese: こっちは床に飛び散らせるほど汗だくだっていうのに、セイバーは汗一つかいていない。
contexts.english: I'm so exhausted, I'm dripping sweat all over the floor. Saber isn't even breathing hard.

findings.description: Saber forgetting how to respond to Shirou's zeal becomes enthusiasm that makes her forget to strike back.
findings.sourceReading: Saber praises Shirou's single-minded, forceful attacks and says their intensity sometimes made her forget her response.
findings.explanation: Saber forgetting how to respond to Shirou's zeal becomes enthusiasm that makes her forget to strike back.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-02:page58:1
contexts.japanese: 「いいえ、そのような事はありません。シロウの打ち込みは一心で、力がありました。時に、あまりの熱心さに対応を忘れたほどです」
contexts.english: "That is not true. Your attacks were all quite powerful. I was so enthused by your efforts that I forgot to strike back at times."

findings.description: The survivors Shirou can save become survivors who can save others, changing Archer's criticism of the limits of rescue.
findings.sourceReading: Archer says Shirou's method can save only those who have survived.
findings.explanation: The survivors Shirou can save become survivors who can save others, changing Archer's criticism of the limits of rescue.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-03:page21:1
contexts.japanese: 「だが間違えるな。おまえが気取る正義の味方とは、ただの掃除屋だ。その方法で救えるものは、生き残った者だけと知れ」
